notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1b Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Highlights[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Subscriber Only Log In Rewards[/b][/p][p]From September 9 to December 9, 2025, active Subscribers will notice a new type of Log In Reward named Subscriber Login Tokens. Subscribers who log in at least four times a week will receive these tokens and will be able to redeem them at a special vendor that carries gameplay focused rewards. See details here. [/p][p][b]Feast of Prosperity[/b][/p][p]SWTOR’s annual fall event returns October 7, 2025! A plethora of new rewards are coming to the Feast of Prosperity event. [/p][p][b]Extended maintenance [/b][/p][p]Alongside the below bug fixes, we will also be deploying Game Server Database upgrades which will require an extended maintenance window. Players should expect an estimated downtime of 8 hours. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Rishi] Sergeant Zaya is no longer missing her head.[/p][/*][*][p]\[French client only] Fixed an issue causing a “Lana accepted the marriage proposal” prompt to appear even if the player is not in a romance with her. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the sorting function on various windows in the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various buttons throughout the game that were not being displayed properly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the Large Tooltip not displaying the proper color when the mouse cursor hovers over friendly and enemy NPCs and interactable items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the fonts on the Combat Style Forcer user alignment button to not display correctly. [/p][/*][*][p]UI elements no longer stack on top of one another when a player joins or quits a group while the Activity Window is open. [/p][/*][*][p]The Group Finder UI now correctly shows a lockout when a player logs in on a character with an active lockout.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Missions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Missing crit path missions are now accessible through the Eras tab offering players guidance on what content needs to be completed in order to begin expansion story content.  [/p][/*][*][p]For players who are unable to start Rise of the Hutt Cartel, they can pick up the necessary Ilum missions from the Eras tab.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Knights of the Fallen Empire, Chapter 7] Subtitles and audio dialogue now match as intended. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Seasons[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Galactic Season] The T7-01 Rugged Customization is no longer missing its Collections Unlock. [/p][/*][*][p]After the weekly reset, the Galactic Season and PvP Season objective trackers will now display the correct amount of completed objectives. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Activity Finder[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Depths of Manaan] After defeating Stivastin through Activity Finder, players will now be placed in the correct location to receive rewards. [/p][/*][*][p]Selecting the "PvP Challenge" activity, then closing and reopening the Activity Window no longer prevents the group leader from joining the queue for any activities.[/p][/*][*][p]The Arena and Warzone queue lists now display the name of characters properly. [/p][/*][*][p]Scrolling to the bottom of the Solo activities list and then collapsing the "Flashpoints" category will now automatically reduce the list's length rather than making it look as though the list has disappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]The scrollbar will now update properly when expanding and collapsing the Solo Tab within the Activity Window.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Nightfall Operative Glasses no longer hide the hoods of chest pieces that have them. [/p][/*][*][p]The Ascendant Admiral’s Belt is now visible on all male body types. [/p][/*][*][p]The account wide versions of the Customization Control: Hide Head Slot and Crew Member Appearance Authorization items can now be sold to vendors. [/p][/*][*][p]When selecting a song from the Republic Jukebox, the two Holo Dancers that appear are no longer missing textures.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Cinematics[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[Spirit of Vengeance] Fixed an issue that caused Rass Ordo to appear with an incorrect hairstyle.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Basilisk Prototype Venture[/b][/p][list][*][p]The timer for B3-S1 when she is a temporary companion does not count down while players are in an Arena or Warzone.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Preferred status players are now able to use equipped gear that requires Artifact Authorization.[/p][list][*][p]Note: If this gear is ever unequipped, players will need to either purchase Artifact Authorization (for character or account) or renew their subscription in order to re-equip that gear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The game no longer crashes to the desktop when the mouse cursor hovers over the Play button, in the mission tracker or map window, during gameplay while certain missions are active.[/p][/*][*][p]Activity Finder will now persist the selected role(s) that players choose while in queue.[/p][/*][*][p]Data has been restored to the columns that were missing information in the Guild Roster Window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue that caused Dark Side Corruption 2 and 3 to render as black on certain skin tones.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1 "Flashpoint Resurgence" is now live!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fb4ca93c07c1d17ec2a4155174ff63c9016f225d.png"][/img][/p][p]Game Update 7.7.1 “Flashpoint Resurgence” is now live! Read below for details about all the content that is available to SWTOR players.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Galactic Season 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence”[/u][/b] [/p][p]Kai Zykken returns with another offer to test a new version of the adrenal boost created by Czerka. The updated Experimental Combat Enhancers will provide even more special buffs upon use when in Flashpoints. Players will be able to make progress through the Free Reward track or the Subscriber Reward track (both tracks are available to Subscribers!) and earn new rewards. [/p][p]A new Galactic Season Flashpoint Resurgence queue has been added to Activity Finder. Every week that Galactic Season 9 is active, this special queue will have 1 or 2 Veteran Flashpoints that match the weekly objectives. [/p][p][b][u]Updates to Activity Finder[/u][/b][/p][p]Improvements to the UI and functionality of the Activity Finder Window have been made that focuses on more support for Combat Styles. Via a new Group Role dropdown, players will be able to choose all roles they are eligible for in the Group tab including the roles from both Combat Styles. Players can now adjust their Combat Styles while waiting for PVE group content. Once the queue pops, the updated Join Window will display the player’s current Combat Style selection and they will need to be sure to match what the Group Finder required role is prior to joining. For convenience, a quick link to Combat Styles and Loadouts has also been added. Players will need to be mindful of the Loadouts they are using and update as needed.[/p][p]Players can now earn the Daily Reward Bonus and Weekly Mission credits even if they do not select every piece of content in the filter.  In the Activity Finder UI players will see two numbers next to each other to explain this information as the following (total available pieces of content // minimum number selected to receive rewards).[/p][p][b][u]Flashpoint Cutscene Skip[/u][/b][/p][p]Players that enter a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint via Activity Finder will find that the cinematic scenes will now skip automatically. The cinematics will be replaced with a brief fade to black. In instances where players would typically make a Light or Dark side choice, a default choice will be made for players and Light/Dark points will not be granted. Should players want to experience the cinematics in a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint, they can manually walk into the phase.[/p][p]In addition, players who complete the below Flashpoints in Veteran Mode via Activity Finder will no longer need to return to the fleet to complete the access mission:[/p][list][*][p]Athiss[/p][/*][*][p]Cademimu[/p][/*][*][p]Hammer Station [/p][/*][*][p]Mandalorian Raiders[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Improvements for F2P/Preferred players[/u][/b][/p][p]F2P/Preferred players will be able to: [/p][list][*][p]Gain access to companion customizations[/p][/*][*][p]Gain access to use Legacy Titles[/p][/*][*][p]Earn Rest XP[/p][/*][*][p]Gain the first Cargo Bay for free[/p][/*][*][p]Use the Hide Head slot[/p][/*][*][p]Withdraw more credits from Escrow when using Cartel Coins[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, all account types will have access to all quickbars. 
[/p][p][b][u]Artifact Authorization[/u][/b][/p][p]Any piece of gear under level 80 will not require Artifact Authorization. [/p][p]Level 80 Artifact (purple) or Legendary (gold) gear that will require Artifact Authorization are: [/p][list][*][p]All 7.0 purple gear[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary Implants[/p][/*][*][p]Hyde and Zeek’s purple enhancements[/p][/*][*][p]Grade 10/11 Reusable Medpacs, Stims, and Adrenals[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u]Security Key Update[/u][/b][/p][p]Players who have a Security Key tied to their account will only receive their Cartel Coin grants if they were active in the last 29 days. We will not be removing coins that have already been granted. To add a Security Key to your SWTOR account, go to your account page on our website. All commonly used authenticators are accepted.[/p][p][b][u]Cartel Market Offerings[/u][/b][/p][p]Alongside the Imperial Scout Mount, the Brushback hairstyle customization, Nightfall Operative Glasses head accessory, and Prototype Test Pilot armor set inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Andor[/i]™ have come to the Cartel Market. Read [u][url="https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250819"]here[/url][/u] for more details. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e6b4b20022a64344013f254feffffd79fef1f87a.png"][/img][i](Brushback Hairstyle)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Character Select Modernization[/u][/b] [/p][p]The character select screen has received improved lighting and a new Depth of Field update that keeps the focus on the player character. Note that these visual updates only apply to the character select screen and not the entirety of the player’s ship. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/20ef85378cdddb4fcbde61f008e6aeca5c60b855.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]Character Modernization[/u][/b] [/p][p]The face definition and texture smoothing that was implemented in Game Update 7.7 has been added to Rattataki. We are also fixing the Dark Side corruption issues some players saw with skin colors turning overly pale. [/p][p]We have unlocked hundreds of hair and montral color options to character customization for Cathar, Chiss, Cyborg, Human, Miraluka, Mirialan, Togruta, and both Imperial and Republic Zabraks. Additionally, more skin colors have been unlocked for Mirialans and Imperial Zabraks. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b824867a6aa1e971a0b807b641f7f9d591365ed3.png"][/img][i](Example of face definition and texture smoothing for Rattataki)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Combat Changes[/u][/b][/p][p]We are continuing with our audit of the default granted abilities and will focus on Mercenary/Commando, Operative/Scoundrel, and Sorcerer/Sage in 7.7.1. A full list can be found in the [u][url="https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes"]patch notes[/url][/u]. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Active Twitch Drop[/u][/b][/p][p]Players will need to watch 4 hours of live Twitch content to get their hands on the TF-6 Striker Mount. Be sure to connect your SWTOR and Twitch account through the account page on our website in order to be eligible to unlock this reward![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6914062787545ccf98746e1253d33a321089dc3c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy Game Update 7.7.1 “Flashpoint Resurgence”! [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: New Star Wars The Old Republic update expands the MMORPG's free-to-play features
notes.notes:
What is it about the Old Republic that makes Star Wars fans all misty eyed? You'd think that the prequel trilogy did enough damage for us not to want more stories from before Luke Skywalker was born. Alas, we're gluttons for punishment and lap up every expanded-universe novel, game, and anything else we can get our hands on. The pinnacle, for me at least, is BioWare's series of RPGs. While many players will fondly remember Knights of the Old Republic and its sequel, MMORPG Star Wars: The Old Republic is a classic in its own right, held back only by its monetisation.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream Recap
notes.notes:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and breakdown of what we showed for the different segments of our livestream.

  [previewyoutube=z0E_bwCPnoM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Active Twitch Drop[/b]

From now until August 13th, watching 1 hour of live content on Twitch will grant you the Coruscant Poster Decoration!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2ab99f4da758bd54033d2475b518e28bc39096e9.png[/img]

At 7.7.1 launch, players will need to watch 4 hours of live Twitch content to get their hands on the TF-6 Striker Mount. 

Be sure to connect your SWTOR and Twitch account through the account page on our website in order to be eligible to unlock these rewards! 
[img {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6914062787545ccf98746e1253d33a321089dc3c.png[/img]
        
[b]Update on story content [/b]

The next story arc will be coming soon! We are working to put the final touches on these storylines and get them into your hands as soon as possible. Galactic Threads is targeted for Game Update 7.8 with Master’s Enigma to follow in 7.8.1. Should this schedule change at all, we will communicate updates on our social channels and forums. 

We are also continuing to work on Date Night content. In Game Update 7.8.1, we are targeting to release two Date Night Missions featuring Kira Carsen and Torian Cadera. We will go into further details on these missions in the game update’s respective livestream. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ba724aec1dc91c1f702c427535de2dbf9f2d0bd7.png[/img]

[b]Galactic Season 9 “Flashpoint Resurgence”[/b]

Galactic Season 9 will begin at 7.7.1 launch and run for 26 weeks. Kai Zykken needs your help once more as a new version of Czerka Combat Enhancers needs to be tested. These new enhancers can be used upon entering Flashpoints and can provide two new buffs.

Experimental Repulsor Field - Grants a temporary Ability Bar that will allow you to lift an enemy and throw them into another. 

Projectile Probes - Two probes will accompany you through the Flashpoint firing projectiles towards enemies while you are in combat. 

[b]Season Rewards[/b]

Titles and Labels 
[list]
    [*]Legacy Title: Ancient[/*]
    [*]Legacy Title: Ambitious[/*]
    [*]Character Title: The Rebel[/*]
    [*]Character Title: Resurged[/*]
    [*]Stronghold Label: Headquarters[/*]
    [*]Stronghold Label: Inner Sanctum[/*]
[/list]
[b]Weapons and Armor[/b]
[list]
    [*]Collapsible and themed weapons[/*]
    [*]Commandant’s Armor Set[/*]
    [*]Ascendant Admiral Armor Set[/*]
[/list]
[b]Mounts[/b]
[list]
    [*]Verdier Econex B1/P1 Mounts[/*]
    [*]Verdier Luxline Mount[/*]
    [*]Minas Stinger Mount[/*]
    [*]Minas Bee Mount[/*]
    [*]Minas Mud Dauber Mount[/*]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5bcdf149e032a9c39ed3610537c587f9a1ad083d.png[/img]
[i](Verdier Econex B1/P1 Mounts)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d468ac538ecedcfd51770dcf7b6486047713155b.png[/img]
[i](Verdier Luxline Mount)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/4e4fd69a235e08eb2f85ce2c99a4a6a46938845d.png[/img]
[i](Minas Stinger Mount / Minas Bee Mount)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/58082fb65b4327e78d7c2de63c19583084c27191.png[/img]
[i](Minas Mud Dauber Mount)[/i]

A variety of decorations can also be earned during the season and will be detailed in a Galactic Season article closer to launch. 

The Meta Achievement Reward is the T7-01 Rugged Customization

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/41862751f65b0ad9ee05662250c27da8c67be7a6.png[/img]
    
[b]System QoL Updates[/b]

[u]Activity Finder [/u]

Improvements to the UI and functionality of the Activity Finder Window have been made that focuses on more support for Combat Styles. Via a new Group Role dropdown, players will be able to choose all roles they are eligible for in the Group tab including the roles from both Combat Styles. They will be able to change their Combat Style while in queue and when a queue pops, players will be able to see the role they have been assigned. Players will need to be cognizant of the Loadouts they are using and update as needed.

In addition to the above updates, a new Galactic Season Flashpoint Resurgence queue will be added to the window. Every week that Galactic Season 9 is active, this special queue will have 1 or 2 Veteran Flashpoints that match the weekly objectives. Players can also join normal queues if they want. 

Players can earn the Daily Reward Bonus and Weekly Mission credits even if they do not select every piece of content in the filter. In the Activity Finder UI, players will see two numbers next to each other to explain this information as the following (total available pieces of content // minimum number selected to receive rewards).  

[u]Flashpoint Cutscene Skip[/u]

Players that enter most Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint via Activity Finder will no longer need to spacebar through cinematic scenes. The cinematics will be replaced with a brief fade to black. In instances where players would typically make a Light or Dark side choice, a default choice will be made for players and Light/Dark points will not be granted. Should players want to experience the cinematics in a Veteran or Master Mode Flashpoint, they can manually walk into the phase. 

As a general note, loot from Flashpoint boss drops have been improved for players under level 75. 

[u]Combat Updates[/u]

We are continuing with our audit of the default granted abilities and will be focusing on Mercenary/Commando, Operative/Scoundrel, and Sorcerer/Sage. There will also be a handful of other balance updates in 7.7.1. Examples are: 
[list]
    [*]Assassin/Shadow - Level 73 ability tree option Avoidance/Celerity now reduces the cooldown of Force Speed by 7s.[/*]
    [*]Operative/Scoundrel - Level 60 ability Exfiltrate/Scamper cooldown changed from 8s to 7s.[/*][/list]
A full list will be posted in the 7.7.1 patch notes as we get closer to launch. 

[u]Security Key Updates[/u]

Players who have a Security Key tied to their account will only receive their Cartel Coin grants if they were active in the last 29 days. We will not be removing coins that have already been granted. 

To add a Security Key to your SWTOR account, go to your account page on our website. Commonly used authenticators can be used.   

[u]F2P/Preferred Improvements[/u]

More changes have been made to improve the F2P experience. Previous updates that have gone into the 7.x patches include: 
[list]
    [*]All players now being able to sprint at Level 1[/*]
    [*]All players can train speeder piloting at level 10[/*]
    [*]Added a mount onboarding mission to guide new players to a speeder vendor[/*]
[/list]
In 7.7.1, F2P/Preferred players will be able to: 
[list]
    [*]Gain access to companion customizations[/*]
    [*]Gain access to use Legacy Titles[/*]
    [*]Earn Rest XP[/*]
    [*]Gain the first Cargo Bay for free[/*]
    [*]Use the Hide Head slot[/*]
    [*]Withdraw more credits from Escrow when using Cartel Coins[/*]
[/list]
In addition to the above, all account types will have access to all quickbars. 

[u]Artifact Authorization Update[/u]

Beginning in Game Update 7.7.1, any piece of gear under level 80 will not require Artifact Authorization. 

Level 80 purple or gold gear that will require Artifact Authorization are: 
[list]
    [*]All 7.0 purple gear[/*]
    [*]Legendary Implants[/*]
    [*]Hyde and Zeek’s purple enhancements[/*]
    [*]Grade 10/11 Reusable Medpacs, Stims, and Adrenals[/*]
[/list]
[b]Subscriber Only Log In Rewards[/b]

From September 9 to December 9, 2025, active Subscribers will notice a new type of Log In Reward in the form of a currency. Subscribers who log in at least four times a week will receive this currency and will be able to redeem it at a special vendor that carries gameplay focused rewards. These rewards can range from purchasing endgame game or leveling gear, special XP and crafting boost, etc… There will also be a unique companion customization reward on the vendor inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Andor[/i]™ that can be used on companion droids 2V-R8 and C2-N2.

[b]Feast of Prosperity[/b]

SWTOR’s annual fall event returns October 7, 2025! A plethora of new rewards are coming to the Feast of Prosperity event. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/da17c77606dcffdc7e29a244d7f9cbe8aeb41bf8.png[/img]
[i](Banquet Hanging Light)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/53901a038f8345206a8e9fcf3894d89fb439346d.png[/img]
[i](Grand Feast Mantel / Regal Wall Shelf)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/12ec3b2745c69114af060d00eb206d635a5a9bb2.png[/img]
[i](Decorations from left to right: Banquet Sculpture, Drinking Banquet Guest (Standing), Banquet Guest (Sitting), Regal Banquet Side Table, Bothan Banquet Guest (Sitting), Banquet Guest (Standing), Grand Feast Carpet (Red))[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6efc0a7fc05891f9f17d32bed8a743c914c12172.png[/img]
[i](Feast Attendee Robe / Feast Attendee Robe (with Scarf) / Feast Attendee Headwrap)[/i]


[b]Cartel Market Offerings[/b]

A new hairstyle customization, head accessory, and outfit inspired by the Disney+ series [i]Andor[/i]™, and an Imperial Scout Mount will be coming to the Cartel Market in 7.7.1. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e6b4b20022a64344013f254feffffd79fef1f87a.png[/img]
[i](Brushback hairstyle)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b2cd666d47d17146f7e49a759daa4c29eb732977.png[/img]
[i](Nightfall Operative Glasses)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3e8d770dd5443a52213457e2af982472a4630a69.png[/img]
[i](PAV-11 Imperial Scout Mount)[/i]

[b]Cartel Market Sales[/b]

Beginning July 30, 2025, there will be a variety of category sales on the Cartel Market ranging between 30-90% off. Below is the current category sales schedule: 
[list]
    [*]July 30 – Mounts[/*]
    [*]August 11 – Tunings, Toys, and Crystals [/*]
    [*]August 23 – Weapons[/*]
    [*]September 4 – Armor[/*]
    [*]September 16 - Decorations[/*][/list]

[b]Character Selection Modernization [/b]

Our modernization efforts continue across the game. The character select screen has received improved lighting and a new Depth of Field update that keeps the focus on the player character. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/20ef85378cdddb4fcbde61f008e6aeca5c60b855.png[/img]

[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b] 

We are now moving on to modernizing other species. The face definition and texture smoothing that was implemented in Game Update 7.7 has been added to Rattataki. We are also fixing the Dark Side corruption issues some players saw with skin colors turning overly pale. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b824867a6aa1e971a0b807b641f7f9d591365ed3.png[/img]
[i](Example of face definition and texture smoothing for Rattataki)[/i]

Additionally, we unlocked hundreds of hair and montral color options to character customization for Cathar, Chiss, Cyborg, Human, Miraluka, Mirialan, Togruta, and both Imperial and Republic Zabraks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/aece110d10a558f75aaeda795204e339dd415b84.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f1f0a27904b6c45f682a9b76191854d8b00419be.png[/img]

[b]Updates on DirectX 12[/b]

The team now has a functioning version of the game on DX12! Our next steps are to upgrade UI technology and implement baseline shader. We intend on working toward releasing a Technical Alpha on the Public Test Server in the not too distant future. We will communicate further details on the timeline of this test when the team makes further progress. We are very excited for this upgrade to come to SWTOR!

Game Update 7.7.1 “Flashpoint Resurgence” will be coming late August 2025!

notes.title: Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Dynamic Encounters[/b]

First introduced in 7.6, Dynamic Encounters offer a variety of new adventures for players to experience. In addition to Hoth, Tatooine, and Hidden Chain Invasions, with 7.7, new Encounters will become available on: 
[list]
[*] Tython
[*] Korriban
[*] Hutta
[*] Ord Mantell
[*] Coruscant
[*] Dromund Kaas
[*] Ilum
[/list]
[b]Relentless Replication Master Mode[/b]

The highest difficulty for Relentless Replication has been released in Game Update 7.7! With it comes new Achievements and rewards to earn including Legendary Augments and themed mount!

[u]Augment Updates[/u]

Legendary Augments will now be available with Master Mode Relentless Replication! Crafters brave enough to defeat XR-53, with a little luck, can begin their crafting journey into our new Legendary implants. For those of you that may not want to venture into Master Mode just yet, we are making some adjustments to our PvP Weekly Missions and Veteran Mode Relentless Replication for a few alternate paths to the new Augments as well.

Read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940135-legendary-augments-coming-in-patch-77/]here[/url] for all the details! 

[b]Eras Window[/b]

Whether you are a new, returning, or seasoned player, the Eras Window will guide you in your journey through SWTOR’s story. Content from the game’s launch to the present is categorized into Eras, providing summaries for each as well as a chronological visual guide to the story. The Eras Window will show you where you are in the overall crit path storyline, what you’ve completed, and what is still to come for each of your characters. 

This window also acts as a great refresher if you are coming back to a character you haven’t played in some time as the overviews are tailored to your journey, show you where that character is in the overall narrative, and allow them to quickly jump directly into their next Mission! 

Important note: Players should expect a larger download for this update as the Eras Window will be importing all the cinematic trailers and this will affect the download size for 7.7.  

[b]Mission Log Updates[/b]

Alongside the introduction of the Eras Window, we have also made a few Quality of Life improvements to the Mission Log to help in ensuring that important information is easier to find as you move through the game. Some of the key changes we made include:

[list]
[*] Introduction of a Galaxy Map button within your Mission Log for easier navigation from Missions to galactic travel!
[*] Reorientation of various UI elements for improved navigation.
[*] Adjustments to make Mission Prioritization clearer (Ex: reduction of non-crit path Missions using Purple)
[/list]
[b]PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild”[/b]

PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild” begins with 7.7 launch and will run for 16 weeks! 

Alongside the new season, we will be providing players with a Cartel Coin purchase option to bring more parity with other seasonal content such as Galactic Seasons. Catch up via credits will still be available. Read [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%255Bnews-category%255D/20250527]here[/url] for details on the new rewards! 

[b]Additional Quality of Life Improvements[/b] 

[u]World Map[/u] 

We have made a host of quality of life improvements to the World Map to help in navigating the Galaxy! The first thing to note is that we have added a 3 section accordion menu to the left side of the World Map: 
[list]
[*] Quick Travel - This now has a filter button that can be used as a toggleable shortcut to quickly isolate Quick Travel points in respect to important Mission icons. Toggling it off will put your filters right back to your original preference!
[*] Encounters - The most exciting of the new sections, the Encounters section will highlight all available Dynamic Encounters in your area. Clicking on one will begin tracking it, this will act as an aid to help breadcrumb you straight to the event location
[*] Filters - The Galaxy Map, Filter options, and Magnifying Glass have been organized into this small utility menu.
[/list]
[b]Combat Updates[/b]

We want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default choices that we make within your Combat Style. We’ve reevaluated the default choices within Disciplines and have made a variety of changes in 7.7. 

A full list of changes is listed below in the Combat Updates section of the patch notes. 

[b]Cartel Market items[/b]

Two new armors (inspired by Andor™), a Manaan mini-sub mount, and a Nar Shaddaa decoration bundle have come to the Cartel Market! See [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528]here[/url] for more details! 

[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b]

Coming in 7.7 are the following: 
[list]
[*] Further definition changes
[*] Chiss Texture Improvements
[*] Preview Window and Game Lighting Parity 
[/list]
We’re continuing to work on modernization for additional species to be released in future updates. Read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940324-character-modernization-updates-going-into-77]here[/url] for additional details. 

[b]Expanded Customization Options! [/b]

New skin colors will be available to all players with 7.7! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new skin colors added to their skin customization sliders.

[b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife[/b]

SWTOR’s summer seasonal event returns with a plethora of new rewards and will begin on July 8th! More details on the new rewards will be posted the first week of July. 

[u]General [/u]
[list]
[*] Movement bonuses will now stack correctly with Sprint. 
[*] This does not affect mounts
[*] When a player begins a task or a mission that requires their companion to be desummoned (such as while controlling droids, etc.), the companion will now be properly resummoned when the task or mission is completed.
[*] Corrected many instances across the game of companions not being resummoned after players return from a polymorph state.
[*] Weapons Tunings that are always visible will now be displayed in cinematics. 
[*] The cinematic scenes for arriving on Makeb and CZ-198 now play as intended. 
[*] The path to the Corellian Datacron is no longer impeded by a troublesome tree. 
[*] Imperial players will no longer be teleported to an unplayable area when exiting their Strongholds.
[/list]
[u]Dynamic Encounters[/u]
[list]
[*] [Tatooine: In Search of a Problem] Fixed an issue with the facial textures for the Imperial Scientists. 
[*] [Hoth: White Maw Assault] The encounter will now correctly share progress if the fight is started by a player who has already completed the event. 
[*] [Hoth: Hidden Chain Invasion] The encounter will now correctly progress to the “Defeat the Hidden Chain Lieutenant” step even if the fight is started by a player who has already completed the event. 
[/list]
[u]Galactic Seasons[/u]
[list]
[*] The “Regal Senator” and “Senator’s Consort” hairstyles are now unlocked account wide. 
[*] The Key to West Wing Exterior and Suite item no longer disappears from the vendor if the player purchases the Key to the East Wing Exterior and Suite for the Copero Stronghold first. 
[/list]
[u]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife[/u]
[list]
[*] Players will now see an alert and a chat text indicating when they have won the “Good Karma” and “Feeling Lucky” buffs. 
[*] Players will be able to use the “Smuggler’s Luck” machine after receiving a Push.
[/list] 
[u]Relentless Replication Operation Boss[/u]
[list]
[*] The Shielded buff is no longer missing its icon. 
[*] Updated the “Becoming The Hunter” and “Just Stay Calm” Achievement descriptions to clarify that it can only be completed on Veteran and Master Mode difficulties. 
[*] All Relentless Replication Achievements now award Achievement points as intended.
[*] The Hungering Bite Ability no longer affects players who are outside of the displayed VFX effect. 
[*] Updated the spawn conditions for the Mistaken Constructs so only one Construct is summoned at a time. 
[*] Mistaken Constructs spawned from the fourth Prime Directive now engage players in combat as intended. 
[*] The Aura of Rust debuff no longer uses the same icon as the Digestive Enzyme debuff. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the map notes for the elevator inside the Imperial Base Camp and phase gate not displaying correctly.
[/list] 
[u]Uprisings [/u]
[list]
[*] [Done and Dusted: Story Mode] The following changes have been made to the Bel Nerodia and G9-RX boss fight: 
[*] Lowered total amount of additional enemies that spawn during the encounter
[*] Reduced damage output from bosses  
[*] Additional enemies will despawn if players are defeated
[*] [Crimson Fang: Port Nowhere] Fixed an issue with part of the boss encounter room glitching when players moved their camera.   
[/list]
[u]Missions[/u]
[list]
[*] [DAILY] Capture and Release Mission obtained from the Onderon terminal now displays the mission item icon when the mission is being tracked. 
[*] [Remote Trading Outpost: Contact the Manufacturer] Players will now receive the correct mail if they abandon the mission. 
[/list]
[u]Dantooine Abundance Spring Festival[/u]
[list]
[*] [DAILY] Pirates. Again. When entering the polymorph state to become a turret, the companion is desummoned. 
[/list]
[u]Items[/u]

[/list]

Vengeance Juggernaut:

notes.title: New Star Wars The Old Republic update reinvigorates the classic MMORPG's planets
notes.notes:
Back before FF14 won my heart, it was Star Wars: The Old Republic, not World of Warcraft, that first sold me on the idea of MMORPGs. I already had a lot of love for the galaxy far, far away, and while it's not explicitly Knights of The Old Republic 3, SWTOR does have the storytelling chops to follow in the footsteps of the iconic Bioware and Obsidian RPGs. Add in the ability to experience those tales in co-op with your friends, and its availability as a free Steam game, and it's certainly worth trying. To give you one more reason, it's just had a fresh injection of life.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Game Update 7.7 Content Now Available on the Public Test Server!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b4dd948a4f6181cb78d4625cedbd19780cebdb3b.png[/img]

[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250509]Content for Game Update 7.7 “Dynamic Worlds”[/url] is now available on the Public Test Server (PTS)! Read below to know exactly what will be on the PTS and where you can leave feedback. 

[b]Dynamic Encounters[/b]

New encounters will be available on the following planets:
[list]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940087-tython-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Tython[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940088-korriban-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Korriban[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940089-ord-mantell-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Ord Mantell[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940090-hutta-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Hutta[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940091-dromund-kaas-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*oxwkaf*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Dromund Kaas[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940092-coruscant-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Coruscant[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940093-ilum-dynamic-encounters-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]Ilum[/url]
[/list]

To help organize feedback, we will have a feedback thread for each planet. Each of the links above will take you to said thread. 

[b]Eras Window[/b]

As this content changes depending on where your character is in the story, we highly encourage players to transfer characters over from live, ideally in as many varied game / story states as possible!

Leave feedback on this content [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940094-eras-window-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]!

[b]Relentless Replication Master Mode [/b]

RRMM returns for another round on the PTS! As with previous testing, while vendors will be available for gearing, we recommend players transfer their characters over so they can have the most authentic experience with taking down XR-53. 

A full list of patch notes/updates that have been implemented into this iteration of the encounter and info on the new Legendary Augments will be found in the feedback thread [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940096-master-mode-xr-53-feedback-thread-as-of-may-8th/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]. 

[b]UI/UX updates for Mission Log and World Map[/b]

A number of UI/UX updates have been made for easier readability and navigation for the Mission Log window and the World Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db4cdd998363013e7d72c4c0a4811b03ea5ace9c.png[/img]
[i](Mission Log as it will be displayed in Game Update 7.7)[/i]

Feedback for these can be left [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940097-uiux-mission-log-and-world-map-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1ct43oq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]! 

[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b]

This iteration of Character Modernization updates will have three main focuses: 
[list]
[*] Further definition changes
[*] Chiss Texture Improvements
[*] Preview Window and Game Lighting Parity
[/list]
Leave feedback for Character Modernization [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940095-character-modernization-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1lj78rd*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]here[/url]. 

[b]Combat Changes[/b]

To reiterate, we want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default Discipline choices. We’ve reevaluated what the current default talent choices within Disciplines are and have adjusted the levels in which they are acquired and adjusted the selected default Disciplines (where necessary). 

A full changelist can be found in this [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/940126-combat-changes-feedback-thread/?_gl=1*1ct43oq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]feedback thread[/url]. 

New skin colors will be available on the PTS! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new skin colors added to their skin customization sliders. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f1256c2b76ef021af5a0b4b1aec8d6bf47a635ac.png[/img]
[i](Blue Cathar and purple Twi'lek) [/i]


If this is your first time playing content on the PTS, [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/868200-getting-started-on-the-pts/?_gl=1*1ct43oq*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTE4NDkyMjgwNS4xNzQ2Nzk5NTk1*_ga_ZR3QR976SN*czE3NDY3OTk1OTUkbzEkZzAkdDE3NDY3OTk1OTUkajAkbDAkaDA.]read this post[/url] to learn how to get started!

**PTS is only available in English[/i]

notes.title: Game Update 7.7 Recap
notes.notes:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.7 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and breakdown of what we showed for the different segments of our livestream.

[previewyoutube=0M8p0avi-kY;full][/previewyoutube]

A new Twitch Drop is now active until May 22nd! In order to obtain the Dromund Kaas Poster Decoration, you must watch 1 hour of live SWTOR content on Twitch. Be sure to connect your Twitch and SWTOR account on the website so you can earn this new deco today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5ed186158ce1323038ac78196b72c21867ca0e0e.png[/img]

When 7.7 goes live (date TBD), players will be able to earn another Twitch Drop reward. 

The Umbaran Holo-Rancor Mount will be unlocked after 5 hours of watch time and earnable for 28 days following 7.7 launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/81d8121dea7f73daa3ea67179523036f592d1de7.png[/img]

[b]Current Rewards Reminders![/b]

Redeem code “SWTORSWC25” to unlock the Amethyst Vulptilla Minipet. Go to your account page on swtor.com to redeem this cute reward before May 30th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5f78da22d782d8c61dbeca9686e71c81ae8c89d2.png[/img]

Players who have active subscription as of May 23rd will receive the Naboo Type-C Speeder Mount! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/60d810a0f9da124056192f45e38ba64351f622b6.png[/img]

[b]May 4th Celebrations! [/b]

From May 1st to May 16th, the following will be available for all SWTOR players: 
[list]
[*] 50% Collections Unlock Sale
[*] Cartel Market items under the Inspired By The Mandalorian™ tab will be 25-75% off
[*] Double XP Event
[*] Log in and receive an exclusive B25-SAL Probe Droid Mini-Pet!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/407420f74179fe18f9e9d6a4b4cb18c53ad43251.png[/img]

[b]Narrative Updates[/b]

There are story spoilers ahead if you did not complete Game Update 7.5: Desperate Defiance! 

In case you missed, a special Darth Malgus teaser video made its debut during Star Wars Celebration in Tokyo, Japan. 

[previewyoutube=7Hst-cfWAGE;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]Galactic Threads[/u]

As a refresher, the events in Galactic Threads immediately follow the conclusion of Desperate Defiance (Game Update 7.5). As you pursue Darth Malgus and Shae Vizla, you will also investigate the puzzle that is Darth Nul’s holocron, track the threat of the Hidden Chain, and uncover Malgus’ ultimate plans for the galaxy.

[u]Master’s Enigma[/u]

Master’s Enigma immediately follows the events of Galactic Threads. Players will be diving into a deeper investigation into Darth Nul’s holocron and discover a mysterious figure who has been pulling strings from behind the scenes… 

A note about story content. Galactic Threads was our intended 7.6 storyline with Master’s Enigma intended for 7.7. The development for these story updates has continued on and it is nearly finished! Once we have all the missing pieces to complete this content, we will be communicating how they will be released for players to enjoy. We are eager for everyone to experience the next chapters of Legacy of the Sith, and we appreciate your patience!

[b]Eras Window[/b]

Whether you are a new, returning, or seasoned player, the Eras Window will guide you in your journey through SWTOR’s story. Content from the game’s launch to the present is categorized into Eras, providing summaries for each as well as a chronological visual guide to the story. The Eras Window will show you where you are in the overall crit path storyline, what you’ve completed, and what is still to come for each of your characters. 

This window also acts as a great refresher if you are coming back to a character you haven’t played in some time as the overviews are tailored to your journey, show you where that character is in the overall narrative, and allow them to quickly jump directly into their next Mission!

[b]Mission Log Updates[/b]

Alongside the introduction of the Eras Window, we have also made a few Quality of Life improvements to the Mission Log to help in ensuring that important information is easier to find as you move through the game. Definitely check out the before and after images to spot the differences but some the key changes we made include:
[list]
[*] Introduction of a Galaxy Map button within your Mission Log for easier navigation from Missions to galactic travel!
[*] Reorientation of various UI elements for improved navigation.
[*] Adjustments to make Mission Prioritization clearer (Ex: reduction of non-crit path Missions using Purple)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/aa6d7cbc947e4311689680b1a238ddd2f49448d6.png[/img]
(Mission Log currently live)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db4cdd998363013e7d72c4c0a4811b03ea5ace9c.png[/img]
(Mission Log as it will be displayed in Game Update 7.7)

[b]Relentless Replication Master Mode[/b]

The highest difficulty for Relentless Replication will be released in Game Update 7.7! With it comes new Achievements and new rewards to earn. New rewards include both Legendary Augments and a brand new Mount!

[u]Augment Updates[/u]

Legendary Augments will now be available with Master Mode Relentless Replication! Crafters brave enough to defeat XR-53, with a little luck, can begin their crafting journey into our new Legendary implants. For those of you that may not want to venture into Master Mode just yet, we are making some adjustments to our PvP Weekly Missions and Veteran Mode Relentless Replication for a few alternate paths to the new Augments as well.

[u]Replication Throne Mount[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ea3458b913ba28d8756dcad46689a34c0c207f2b.png[/img]

[b]PvP Season 8 “Champions of the Wild”[/b]

A new PvP season begins with 7.7 launch and will run for 16 weeks! Season 8 “Champions of the Wild” comes with new rewards:
[list]
[*] Bestial Champion’s Armor Set
[*] Bestial Warrior’s Armor Set
[*] Armor Set of the Wild
[*] Armor Set of the Beast 
[*] Legacy Title: Way of the Warrior
[*] Character Title: Stalker of Prey
[*] Season 8 Battle Flags (Red and Blue)
[*] Season 8 Trophy Decorations (Small and Large)
[*] Champion’s Seat Decoration
[*] Throne of the Beast Decoration
[*] Wild Warrior’s Respite Decoration
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/70e8f6b17f07946df3a4d6eae2130de492df9741.png[/img]
(Bestial Champion’s Armor Set)

[b]PvP Season 8 System Update[/b]

Alongside the new season, we will be providing players with a Cartel Coin purchase option to bring more parity with other seasonal content such as Galactic Seasons. Catch up via credits will still be available. 


[b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife Event[/b]

Nar Shaddaa Nightlife returns July 8th! This seasonal event will run for 6 weeks until August 19th. New rewards will be available once this event goes live!

New rewards include: 
[list]
[*] Supernova Helmet 
[*] Smuggler’s Trained Vine Cat
[*] Smuggled Sithspawn
[*] Fiery Grefna 
[*] Vixian Youngling
[*] Iridescent Varactyl
[*] Emperor's Mewvorr
[*] Luxury Ice Tromper
[*] Pocket Orlax
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b1278a69a2e7cbc9e2ab9834da164404b9bea323.png[/img]
(Supernova Helmet)


[b]New Dynamic Encounters[/b]

First introduced in 7.6, Dynamic Encounters offer a variety of new adventures for players to experience. In addition to Hoth, Tatooine, and Hidden Chain Invasions, with 7.7 new Encounters will become available on: 
[list]
[*] Tython
[*] Korriban
[*] Hutta
[*] Ord Mantell
[*] Coruscant
[*] Dromund Kaas
[*] Ilum
[/list]

With these new Dynamic Encounters comes a plethora of new rewards to earn! Players can expect the following themed rewards: 
[list]
[*] Coruscant Conspiracy Console
[*] Coruscant Construction Crane
[*] Coruscant Fireworks Launcher
[*] Coruscant Shipping Cargo
[*] Coruscant Uggernaught
[*] Dromund Kaas Broadcast Tower
[*] Dromund Kaas Hanging Cage
[*] Dromund Kaas Mining Drill
[*] Dromund Kaas Sarcophagus
[*] Hutta Poison Pit Sign
[*] Ilum Crystal Node
[*] Ilum Kolto Tank
[*] Ilum Turret
[*] Ord Mantell Fire Barrell
[*] Ord Mantell Wardrobe
[*] Tython Statue
[*] Tython Training Bay
[*] Killik Stalker Larva Pet
[*] Starter Planet Mounts
[*] Capital Planet Mounts
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0a7d6dac1a4fa4f6516fa4c642cdf3b84239113d.png[/img]
(Killik Stalker Larva Pet)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/74a65562bcdf58d768ebcaf637f3f8961143305d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/32cb2459d857ec1230bae90cffaa52766f1b5fa1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/02f6166978115b00959443952ab38ff1f5f7390c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9d03541937e765114257fc8c9e52728c16443510.png[/img]
(Starter Planet Mounts)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b46c8a09a910c87730e85a0efcd6193913c84b25.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e49e6b90b05f17c19f5b1250b35779b86d5d5035.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/092dcaacf12c66c062e6f65f61fb27484a51331d.png[/img]
(Capital Planet + Ilum Mounts)


[b]Additional Quality of Life Improvements [/b]

World Map 

We have made a host of quality of life improvements to the World Map to help in navigating the Galaxy! The first thing to note is that we have added a 3 section accordion menu to the left side of the World Map, let’s talk about what is in each of those sections!
[list]
[*] Quick Travel - This now has a filter button that can be used as a toggleable shortcut to quickly isolate Quick Travel points in respect to important Mission icons. Toggling it off will put your filters right back to your original preference!
[*] Encounters - The most exciting of the new sections, the Encounters section will highlight all available Dynamic Encounters in your area. Clicking on one will begin tracking it, this will act as an aid to help breadcrumb you straight to the event location
[*] Filters - The Galaxy Map, Filter options, and Magnifying Glass have been organized into this small utility menu.
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Combat Updates[/b]

We want to ensure that players have a viable, fun, and fantasy-fulfilling experience from the default choices that we make within your Combat Style. We’ve reevaluated the default choices within Disciplines and are making a variety of changes.

In 7.7, we’ll make changes to:
[list]
[*] Vengeance Juggernaut and Vigilance Guardian
[*] Carnage Marauder and Combat Sentinel
[*] Marksman Sniper and Sharpshooter Gunslinger
[*] Deception Assassin and Infiltration Shadow
[*] Now Hatred Assassin and Serenity Shadow by default[list]
[*] We will be targeting 7.7.1 for the next round of updates. A full list of 7.7 combat updates will be able for players to check out when the Public Test Server opens. 
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Cartel Market items[/b]

Two new armors (inspired by Andor™), a mount, and a repackaged decoration bundle will be coming to the Cartel Market with 7.7!


Guerilla Commander’s Armor 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/44f1ebcd522e0ad210d88d5275731c5b1492f9ce.png[/img]

Imperial Director’s Armor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/144fc83e85e52fa178467aeb2dd69e3779b239b2.png[/img]


Manaan Mini-sub Mount
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/40dbb6cd8e75a995754bfe6a2b24982a95455ffd.png[/img]

The Nar Shaddaa Decoration Bundle includes: 
[list]
[*] Dejarik Table x 10
[*] Landscape: Gold Plated Hutt x 8
[*] Casino Table x 8
[*] Promenade Lanterns (Small) x 8
[*] Speeder Turntable Display x 6
[*] Ambient Machine: Casino x 6
[*] Holo Sign: Welcome to Nar Shaddaa x 6
[*] Holo Sign: Cantina Dancer x 6
[*] Holo Sign: Bith Musician x 6
[*] Trandoshan Mercenary x 6
[*] Cantina Bouncer x 6
[*] Jukebox: Core World Classics x 6
[*] Contraband Slot Machine x 6
[*] Promenade Holotree Bench (Blue/Purple) x 4
[*] Promenade Holotree Bench (Purple) x 4
[*] Promenade Holotree Bench (Yellow) x 4
[*] Promenade Holotree Bench (Green/Red) x 4
[*] Promenade Lanterns (Large) x 4
[*] Upbeat Twi'lek Dancer (Female) x 4
[*] Upbeat Mirialan Dancer (Female) x 4
[*] Hutt Crime Boss x 3
[/list]
Note that the above decorations are already live in the game currently, but some of them can be difficult to obtain. We grouped them together in one convenient bundle for ease of accessibility! 


[b]Character Modernization Updates[/b]

Coming in 7.7 are the following: 
[list]
[*] Further definition changes
[*] Chiss Texture Improvements
[*] Preview Window and Game Parity Along with Lighting, Environment, and Rendering Improvements 
[/list]

The above will be available on the Public Test Server before launch. We’re continuing to work on modernization for additional species to be released in future updates. 


[b]Expanded Customization Options! [/b]

New skin colors will be available to all players with 7.7! Cathar, Chiss, Mirialan, Nautolan, Sith Pureblood, Togruta, and Twi’lek characters will see an abundance of new skin colors added to their skin customization sliders. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/82445a68245530d5cc004c177f15560c2be56f9c.png[/img]

Game Update 7.7 is targeting a late May/early June release!

[*] Czerka Combat Drones Buff - Drones will assist you in taking your enemies down!

notes.title: Game Update 7.6 debuts Dynamic Encounters and The Propagator Core XR-53
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b432df44ff75b7c119e4b7c64921ed5b77e7a649.png[/img]

[u][b]Dynamic Encounters[/b][/u]

Dynamic Encounters is new world content that breathes life into planets and offers a wide variety of repeatable activities that rotate their availability over time. This content makes its debut with Game Update 7.6 and can be found on Tatooine and Hoth. 

When players make their way to either of these planets with the Galaxy Map, they can immediately see which Encounters are active. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/22be02235bdd0add3ccba0bb18285805dff1d52c.png[/img]

As players venture out and explore, they will see unique icons pop up on their map indicating that a Dynamic Encounter is currently active. Once a player is close enough to the Encounter, the mission tracker will update with a description of the Encounter and what requirements need to be fulfilled in order to complete the Encounter. All encounters can be completed solo or in a group. There are two different types of encounters: those that share progress normally (only with others in your group) and those that share progress between all active players in the encounter area--even if you aren't in a group. These use different icons to let you know which is which. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9e531b12bf90f8087c485b45f1ff6e4d9eb7f676.png[/img]

[u]What kind of Dynamic Encounters are there? [/u]

Though you may be tasked to take down enemy NPCs and mini bosses, not every Encounter requires combat! On Hoth, you may need to calm some anxious Ice Kittens or carry baby Tauntauns up a hill just so they can happily run down it and back to their mother. On Tatooine, you may come across a Cantina band experiencing travel woes and you need to help repair their vehicles or become an Ad Gonk droid and market their show to patrons. 

[b]Hidden Chain Invasions[/b] are unique Dynamic Encounters that can occur on Tatooine, Hoth, Rishi, and Ilum. Stop Heta Kol’s forces from wreaking havoc in the galaxy by summoning friendly NPC faction forces to take down the Hidden Chain and earn rewards for doing so. 

[u]What are the rewards? [/u]

There are a number of rewards that can be earned as Dynamic Encounters are completed! Alongside numerous Achievements, players can earn Conquest Commendations, Tech Fragments, Mounts, a unique decoration, and armor sets! 

Hidden Chain Invasions Encounters will drop pieces of the Hidden Chain armor set and various Encounters on Hoth and Tatooine will drop pieces of the Electric Gaze armor set. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3386e38280d6b241c7f6eb5cb686766292192277.png[/img]

Completing specific (and also rare) Dynamic Encounters on Hoth may drop the Everglade Zakkeg mount and the Hoth Snowcap decoration. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/37c51350d6b0275356923611a658ecf4bed58e0d.png[/img]

A rare and unique Freckled Loth-cat Kitten pet can be obtained upon completing kitten related Dynamic Encounters on Hoth. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/03ef42bf32ab9d57f9b986348cb3f0146c149bfe.png[/img]

Upon completing the meta-Achievement for Hoth, players will receive the Frozen Peaks Mount. Completing the meta-Achievement for Tatooine will yield the Desert Sand Mount. Both mounts come with mini-pet functionality! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f138cea2eda9f27e8136596a763474736066e307.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/614d89158ed280f74bf50d8099ef499600fbce6e.png[/img]

We look forward to creating more missions for other planets in the future! 



[u][b]The Propagator Core XR-53 Operation Boss on Story and Veteran Mode![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6c52b49737dc4746c55d575cdcbf75ceb2fca92c.png[/img]

The Propagator Core XR-53 originated from one of the many broken pieces when the Emperor's Fortress crashed onto Ilum. The XR-53 is a Rakatan droid replicator trying to fix itself by harvesting resources. As players explore an abandoned production lab on Ilum, they may find themselves the XR-53’s newest targets to be collected. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/91ed2d47241df6f4087036da4df5fc91e9904c47.png[/img]
(Complete Construct enemy NPC)

There are two ways to begin the encounter. Players can: 

[list]
[*] Fly to Ilum and approach the phase gate located in the main base camp
[*] Use the Group Activity Finder window and choose “Relentless Replication” for Story Mode
[list]
[*] For a limited time, Relentless Replication will be the only Encounter listed in the window 
[/list][/list]
Players are encouraged to jump into a 8-player group and take down XR-53 not only for the excitement of a challenging fight, but also because this boss drops the needed components to craft new augments! 

Three new tiers of augments have been introduced with 7.6: 

[list]
[*] Augment 83 (Item Rating, 296 Prototype)
[list]
[*] The tradeable Schematic to craft these will drop from the XR-53 fight on Story Mode [/list]
[*] Augment 86 (Item Rating 302, Prototype) [list]
[*] The tradeable Schematic to craft these will drop from the XR-53 fight on Veteran Mode[/list]
[*] Advanced Augment 86 (Item Rating 310, Artifact)[list]
[*] The schematic is only available by deconstructing Augment 86.[/list][/list]

A full breakdown of these augments can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937613-new-augments-coming-in-patch-76]here[/url]. 

A full list of the updated schematics and requirements can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937613-new-augments-coming-in-patch-76/page/2/#findComment-9832364]here[/url]. 


We hope you enjoy Dynamic Encounters and the new Operation boss!

[b]Steam launcher[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[list]

Powerful Construct

notes.title: SWTOR to release inactive character names with Game Update 7.6
notes.notes:
We’ve been looking for opportunities to release inactive character names, and we have selected 7.6 launch as the time to begin this process. Please read through this blog in its entirety to understand how you can keep your character name if it was impacted. 

[b]For players who are Subscribers on 7.6 launch[/b]
[list]
[*] None of your character names will be impacted
[/list]
[b]For players who have a F2P or Preferred account[/b]
[list]
[*] If you have not logged into a character since January 1, 2024, that character name will be released into an unreserved pool and can potentially be claimed by another player with 7.6 launch 
[*] If you would like to keep your character name, you must log into the game before 7.6 launch. 
[list]
[*]If you want to keep every character name, you must log in with every character before the  7.6 launch. 
[/list][*] If you are an active Subscriber at 7.6 launch, all of your character names will be preserved.
[/list]
[b]If you are a player who loses their claim on a character name:[/b]
[list]
[*] When you log into that character again, you will receive an opportunity to rename your character for free.
[/list]
[b]If you are a player who wants to claim a released name:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can create a new character
[*] You can purchase the Rename: Character Name Consumable item and rename an existing character
[list]
[*]For one week following 7.6 launch, this item will be 90% off
[/list][/list]
The current launch schedule for 7.6 is early December. We wanted to give players advanced notice of this upcoming action. 

We will be posting follow ups on our social channels and forums as needed.

notes.title: Game Update 7.6 "Galactic Threads” Recap
notes.notes:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.6 Livestream, don't worry! Below is a VOD and a breakdown of highlights from each segment we showcased on the stream.

7.6 Livestream VOD
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wilyuGT1V-g&t

[u]Twitch Drops [/u]

As a reminder, Twitch Drops are enabled! Be sure to connect your Twitch account to your SWTOR account. Drops will be active at the start of each dev stream and with every game update launch. 

From November 14th to November 28th, players will be able to obtain the Ilum Art Poster decoration (purple frame) after watching one hour of SWTOR content. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3d728430cda2767569567b362409cdc397693dd0.png[/img]

At 7.6 launch, another Twitch Drop campaign will be active. After watching four hours of SWTOR content on Twitch, players will obtain the Amethyst Vulptilla Mount. This campaign will remain active for 28 days following 7.6 launch. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5eeec7fb367b70e73e038a48755cdcde0055af15.png[/img]

[u]Galactic Threads Storyline [/u]

*Story spoilers for Update 7.5 story content in this section*

Galactic Threads begins immediately following the events from the Desperate Defiance storyline. Players and their Alliance race to find Darth Malgus and stop whatever plans he has set in motion. At the same time, players will also seek answers surrounding Darth Nul’s holocron and the Hidden Chain’s ambitions. 

Jekiah and Rass Ordo, Arn Peralun, Major Anri, Talos Drellik, Akaavi Spar, and Lana Beniko will be making a return in this story update. 

Story Missions will be taking players to Hoth, Tatooine, and the digsite at Nul’s temple of Elom. 

There is an important caveat that the team would like to address to set player expectations. While the “Galactic Threads” story chapter is well into production, the SWTOR Narrative team does not currently have all the components needed to deliver high-quality story content that adheres to the team’s standards, as well as player expectations for story. The release date for “Galactic Threads” is currently delayed until this content can be completed. Please note, no other content in Game Update 7.6 is impacted.

[u]Cartel Market Additions, Remote Trading Outpost Decorations, and the Master the Fight: Starbolt Edition Bundle[/u]

A new type of decoration bundle is making its debut with 7.6! The Remote Trading Post bundle is inspired by [i]Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge™[/i].

When initially purchased, players will receive one set of “neglected” decorations. These items will appear broken, damaged, and will need to be fixed! After completing a couple of light gameplay missions, players will receive a full set of fixed decorations.

But that’s not all!  Players will also receive two mini pets, a baby Dianoga and the D5-C0 DJ Droid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c2e94c032af582711b364f549c998fd1efc4c3a9.png[/img]

Also coming to the Cartel Market are [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew™[/i] inspired items including a new armor (plus one variant), an array of weapons, customizations, and new dyes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cf18eef5923480ed7610864c6c9fe9c46ba1bd66.png[/img]
[i](Mysterious Rogue Armor - with jacket and without jacket)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d577d9a4dfa999a995fd1e0deef2c313dfb49dc8.png[/img]
[i](Fearless Buccaneer weapons)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/afc851b19a4110f5d29ae94dbb7807ba73d32651.png[/img]
[i](Fearless Buccaneer lightsaber and dualsaber)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/edd18f09d15978f9cf4b2bbafbf40087dd62399e.png[/img]
[i](Left is default colors. Metallic Gray/Chrome White and Chrome White/Metallic Gray dyes have been applied in the second and third panels) [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e28092fc567bc27661f20842ebafbef142931e72.png[/img]
[i](Long hair customization. This specific hairstyle will be free for all players!)[/i]

The Master the Fight: Starbolt Edition Bundle will be dropping November 15th! This bundle contains: 
[list]
[*] 180 Days Subscription Time + 600 Cartel Coins per month
[*] 5500 Cartel Coins
[*] Vectron 240R Starbolt Mount 
[*] [list]
[*] Rideable at level 1
[*] Comes with Speeder Rank 5
[*] Gives players a speed boost while mounted
[/list]
[*] Primary Metallic Yellow Dye (x5 per character)
[*] Secondary Metallic Yellow  Dye (x5 per character)
[*] Bundle is priced at $99.99 USD
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/720b714a5dd6be23e7fa39c06d032457c291aef0.png[/img]
[i](Vectron 240R Starbolt Mount) [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c31c9c9623b28367da2a8ef427e38b59f8ccc5c5.png[/img]
[i](The left panel shows the armor’s default colors. Primary and Secondary Yellow dyes have been applied in the second and third panels)[/i]

Speaking of dyes! The team has been looking into ways to improve functionality and accessibility to dyes. We will keep you posted on upcoming changes.  In the meantime, [u][b]we are reducing the price of all dyes on the Cartel Market by 50%[/b][/u].  Now is the time to grab those packs you have been dying to own!

[u]Dynamic Encounters and the Propagator Core XR-53 Lair Boss[/u]

Dynamic Encounters is new world content that offers a variety of missions for players to experience. They are meant to breathe life into the planets they inhabit, giving players a sense that something is always happening at any given time. As players explore planets, they will naturally come across Dynamic Encounters or they can find active Encounters on their map. Missions can range from taking out Hidden Chain forces to herding escaped Banthas running amok in a space port. These Encounters will debut on Hoth and Tattoine with 7.6. 

Hidden Chain Invasions are special Dynamic Encounters where players are tasked with stopping Heta Kol’s forces as they continue to wreak havoc in the galaxy. These Encounters can take place on Hoth and Tattooine, but can also be found on several other planets.  

Dynamic Encounters will have a variety of rewards associated with them. Completing Encounters will yield tech fragments and Conquest Commendations, and unlocking Achievements. Hidden Chain Invasion Encounters will drop armor pieces. And a special rare Encounter will drop the Freckled Loth-cat mini pet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3386e38280d6b241c7f6eb5cb686766292192277.png[/img]
[i](Hidden Chain and Electric Gaze Armors)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/03ef42bf32ab9d57f9b986348cb3f0146c149bfe.png[/img]
[i](Freckled Loth-Cat Kitten pet)[/i]

Completing the meta-achievement for the Tatooine and Hoth Encounters will grant players the Desert Sand and Frozen Peaks Mounts. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f138cea2eda9f27e8136596a763474736066e307.png[/img]


[u]Propagator Core XR-53[/u]

A new lair boss will be coming with 7.6. The Propagator Core XR-53 originated from one of the many broken pieces when the Emperor's Fortress crashed onto Ilum. The XR-53 is a Rakatan droid replicator trying to fix itself by harvesting resources. Story and Veteran Modes will launch with 7.6. 

[u]Public Test Server Schedule and Incentives[/u]

Players can earn PTS specific incentives by completing Dynamic Encounters and taking down XR-53 in Story and Veteran Modes. Below is a breakdown of the requirements for each incentive. 

[b]Cutting Edge Title & Kai Zykken’s MK-85 Mount[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with a Republic character on Tatooine and 25 on Hoth
[/list]
[b]Strike Team Hero Title & Kai Zykken’s MK-90 Mount[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters on Tatooine and 25 on Hoth with an Imperial character
[/list]
[b]B1-SAL + First Line of Defense, Strike Team Specialist, Strike Team Commander, and Led the Charge Titles[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete all of the Dynamic Encounters achievements
[/list]
[b]First of Many Title[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Story Mode
[/list]
[b]First Among Veterans Title[/b]
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Veteran Mode
[/list]
All incentives will be granted at 7.6 launch. 

[i]*PTS is only available to Subscribers[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3a4aea3d6a32d75a0f6105195b8375acd1b6d871.png[/img]
(B1-SAL mini pet inspired by Andor)

[u]PvP Season 7[/u]

PvP Season 7’s theme is Path to Mastery, will begin with 7.6 launch, and will run for 16 weeks. Rewards include: 
[list]
[*] New armors and decorations
[*] Honorable Bow Emote
[*] Legacy Title: Pathfinder
[*] Master of Paths Title
[*] Meta-achievement Title: Seeker  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8ea33f7b661113134f0c2b3b7ad5f1bf7742b48e.png[/img]
[i](Plumed Scout and Plumed Trapper Armors. Earned from the reward track)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5520e0bff0ff04345a064b174d519c6d916a5cf0.png[/img]
[i](Feathered Range and Feathered Huntmaster Armors. Can be purchased from PvP vendor)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/32c2b2e1e6e15a5076c64f79ae2fc315d2937f02.png[/img]
[i](PvP Season 7 Battler, small, and large trophy decorations)[/i]

Two holistic changes will also be coming to PvP beginning 7.6: 
[list]
[*] Warzone matching will be updated allowing players to group up with four players max (down from eight).  
[*] Set Bonus effects on the level 75 Spoils of War gear will be disabled during PvP matches.
[/list]

[u]Life Day[/u]

Our winter seasonal event is almost upon us! Life Day will begin mid-December. Two new rewards will be available for players to get!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7b3ac7203c12d533bc107cdefe0d2456108c081c.png[/img]
[i](Tirsa G1-F7 Mount)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6485ee0e6c45f699f7be5d5b4ef8dd00cb8902f4.png[/img]
[i](Life Day Ornate Robes. The left panel shows the default colors. The Havoc Squad red and white dye was applied to the armor in the right panel. )[/i]

[u]Best View in SWTOR 2024[/u]

The Best View finalists have been selected! Winners will be announced soon. 

[u]Mac Launcher Update[/u]

Our technical test is still underway and we are currently gathering and responding to feedback from players who have been invited to the test. Based on the testing, we are now planning to release the Mac Launcher in the near future. We will have more updates to share soon.

[u]Companion Mounts are coming to SWTOR[/u]

The [i]Star Wars: Skeleton Crew™ [/i]inspired Meirm Cicada Mount comes with *companion AND mini pet functionality. 

As a thank you to our players, the Meirm Cicada Mount will be free to players with an active subscription anytime between November 29 – January 4!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/625e0b99cd1b3a53178add28e741fd0c39d67173.png[/img]

*Not all companions are compatible with this mount. As an example, B3-S1 can’t fit!

Remember the Desert Sand and Frozen Peaks Lifter Mounts that can be earned through Dynamic Encounters? Surprise! They come with mini pet functionality too! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/614d89158ed280f74bf50d8099ef499600fbce6e.png[/img]


[u]Freeing Inactive Character Names[/u]

We’ve been looking for opportunities to release inactive character names, and have selected 7.6 launch as the time to begin this process. If you have not logged into a character since January 1, 2024, that character name will be released into an unreserved pool and can potentially be claimed by another player when 7.6 launches. Players who want to keep their character names must log into the game before the 7.6 launch and log into each character. Players who are Subscribers at 7.6 launch will not need to take any action. Read here for more details! 

[u]Modernization [/u]

Our modernization efforts continue on with Game Update 7.6. Players will see updates done to Tython, Korriban, Hoth, and Ilum.

But wait, there’s more! Character models, specifically heads, will also see improved fidelity across the game! Players will see updates to their character via updated character textures, along with ocular specularity and with lighting, and shader improvements. Our goal was to improve the fidelity of characters across the game while keeping your character uniquely yours. Texture changes are starting in this update with Human, Chiss, Cyborg, Miralukan, Mirialan, Togruta, Rattataki, and Zabrak models. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WN7JD4pTpks

Game Update 7.6 is coming early December!

notes.title: Big Star Wars The Old Republic update breathes new life into the 2011 MMORPG
notes.notes:
I will always advocate for Star Wars: The Old Republic. While it never quite reached the heights of rivals like World of Warcraft or Final Fantasy 14, the MMORPG sequel to the KOTOR series is absolutely worth trying if you're a Star Wars fan. It successfully transforms the classic BioWare and Obsidian RPGs into a multiplayer format while still retaining what made them special, and because it's a free-to-play game you can jump in without any commitment. Even better, an Old Republic update has just been unveiled that freshens up its worlds, making now a great time to try it.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Public Test Server Update: Propagator Core XR-53 Changes and Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/0193cbab721f8a7841bb55e982a8089a9a5422ba.png[/img]

We will be releasing a new Public Test Server (PTS) build today at 10am CT / 4pm UTC. Below are the XR-53 (Story Mode) changes that will be included in the build. 

[u][b]General[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Propagator Core XR-53’s health has been reduced to 51M (down from 86M).
[/list]
[u][b]Abilities[/b][/u]

Digestive Enzyme
[list]
[*] Adjusted debuff duration to 20s (up from 15s).
[*] Digestive Enzyme’s damage type is now Internal.
[*] Digestive Enzyme’s per-stack ticking damage increased by 150%.
[/list]
Acidic Rocketry
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 1s (down from 2s).
[*] Rocket travel time increased to 3s (up from 2s).
[*] Propagator Core XR-53 will now be immobilized for 1s after completing the Acidic Rocketry Cast (was 2.5s).
[*] Acidic Rocketry now only targets the four furthest players from the boss in the group, as opposed to all players.
[/list]
Prepare for Harvest
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced from 2s to 1s.
[*] Propagator Core XR-53 will now be immobilized for 1.25s after completing the Prepare for Harvest cast (was 2.5s).
[*] Prepare for Harvest projectile travel time reduced from 2s to 0.5s.
[/list]
Extraneous Expulsion
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 2.5s (down from 4s).
[*] Fixed an issue where Extraneous Expulsion was dealing damage outside of its warning area.
[/list]
Hungering Bite
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 3s (down from 4s).
[*] Fixed an issue where Hungering Bite was dealing damage outside of its warning area.
[/list]
Lethal Strike
[list]
[*] Lethal Strike has been rebalanced. It now gives three different debuffs based on the role of the struck target, each called “Softened Up”. DPS and Healers afflicted with this debuff will now have a looping effect to indicate that they are afflicted with it.
[*] Tank: Lethal Strike deals 250% increased damage to the affected target. 45 second duration.
[*] Healer: All outgoing healing reduced by 75%. 1 minute duration.
[*] DPS: All outgoing damage reduced by 75%. 1 minute duration.
[/list]
Prey Seekers
[list]
[*] Cast time reduced to 1s (down from 3s).
[*] Prey Seeker Droids will now indicate who they are going to jump towards before doing so in order to give players time to react.
[/list]
Imperfect Fabrication
[list]
