notes.title: Game Update 7.6 content is rolling out onto the Public Test Server!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9805d147aa0ea52cf1f70d70cf492f85f9d78e9e.png[/img]

As announced in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tuBOaTpQfCg]7.6 Public Test Server (PTS) video [/url]that was published last week, two new features will be coming to the PTS over the coming weeks. Below are all the details on the roll out schedule and the incentives tied to each.

[u][b]Dynamic Encounters[/b][/u]

Dynamic Encounters are coming to SWTOR in 7.6! As players explore Hoth and Tatooine, they'll notice a new type of Mission popping up on the map. Dynamic Encounters offer a variety of new adventures for players to experience, from rounding up escaped Bantha calves at the spaceport to defeating dangerous bosses or even helping a down-on-its-luck cantina band get back on the road. There are tons of Dynamic Encounters, and which missions are available will cycle throughout the day, giving these iconic planets brand new life.

In addition to these planetary Dynamic Encounters, players can participate in Hidden Chain Invasion Encounters. Heta Kol's forces are growing bold, staging assaults across several planets to secure resources for the Hidden Chain. These special Dynamic Encounters will only be available for a limited time as the Hidden Chain threatens the galaxy, so players will want to jump in and call upon their allies to help thwart their plans!   

Dynamic Encounters can be played solo or in a group, and completing them will net players unique rewards and achievements, giving everyone a great reason to discover these planets all over again.

[u]This feature debuts with PTS starting today![/u]

[u][b]Propagator Core XR-53[/b][/u]

The second feature that players got a sneak peek of last week is info on the new lair boss, the Propagator Core XR-53, and its level design. XR-53 can be found on Ilum as it was once a part of the Emperor’s Fortress that crashed during the Battle of Ilum. [u]This feature will debut in Story Mode next week with Veteran to follow at a later time.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/8e4efb40d7da8fb692d1179f4e72241cc4f801b0.png[/img]
(New boss encounter level design on Ilum)

[b][u]PTS Incentives[/u][/b]

As mentioned in the 7.6 PTS video, we are bringing back previously released PTS incentives and a few new ones! Here is the breakdown on what players need to do in order to obtain past and new incentives! 

[u]Dynamic Encounter Incentives[/u]

To earn the Cutting Edge Title and Kai Zykken’s MK-85 Log Mount, players must: 
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with a Republic character on Tatooine
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with a Republic character on Hoth
[/list]
To earn the Strike Team Hero Title and Kai Zykken’s MK-90 Holo-Log Mount, players must: 
[list]
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with an Imperial character on Tatooine
[*] Complete 25 Dynamic Encounters with an Imperial character on Hoth
[/list]
Completing [u][b]all[/b][/u] of the Dynamic Encounters achievements above will grant players the B1-SAL mini pet droid! Along with this [i]Andor [/i]inspired pet, players will also receive the following titles:  
[list]
[*] First Line of Defense
[*] Strike Team Specialist
[*] Strike Team Commander
[*] Led the Charge
[/list]
[u]Lair Boss Incentives[/u]

To earn the First of Many Title, players must: 
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Story Mode
[/list]
To earn the First Among Veterans, players must:  
[list]
[*] Defeat the Propagator Core XR-53 on Veteran Mode
[/list]
Players will be able to keep track of their progress as they unlock PTS Achievements, however, note that [u]these incentives will be granted at 7.6 launch[/u]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/cffe2dd23a600f5a9b151c836481154244900e82.png[/img]
(B1-SAL mini pet, inspired by [i]Andor[/i])


[u][b]When will the PTS open? [/b][/u]

The PTS is open now and players can get a first look into Dynamic Encounters today! Story Mode for XR-53 will be released next week with Veteran to follow in the weeks after. As always, the PTS sub-forums will be the space where we will be gathering feedback on these two new features. 

Eric Musco announced in the PTS video that we will also be hosting a livestream going over all of the features coming in 7.6 in November. It will be at this time that more content will be released on the PTS for players to check out.

In short, players will have more than a month to experience new content and obtain the PTS incentives.

To get started on the PTS and to leave feedback, read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/937274-76-content-is-now-available-on-the-pts/]here[/url]. 

[i]*PTS is only available for Subscribers.   
*PTS is only available in EN[/i]

[u][b]Galactic Seasons 7 “The Greatest Bounty”[/b][/u]

Players will be meeting up with Kantec Bren of the Bounty Broker Association (BBA) thus kicking off “The Greatest Bounty”. For the entirety of the season, the Bounty Contract Event will be enabled. This season will also feature the world bosses from the Dark vs Light (DvL) event! 

Rewards include new titles, the Brynjak and Superior Hunter Armors, the Furious and Temperamental Brynjak Mounts, new decos, themed weapons, a white Loth-cat kitten pet and more! 

All the details around can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20240820]here[/url].  

[u][b]Date Night
[/b][/u]
Players are now able to experience Vette and Aric Jorgan’s Date Night missions! These Date Night Missions will be available for Troopers and Sith Warriors in active post-KotFE romances. The Orlean Voidstream Mount will be unlocked after 4 hours of watch time and earnable for 30 days following 7.5.1 launch.

[b]7.5.1 Patch Notes[/b]


[h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3]

[b]Galactic Seasons[/b]

Galactic Season 7 “The Greatest Bounty” will begin with the launch of Game Update 7.5.1 on August 20th! Once the update is live, players will be able to make progress through the Free or Subscriber Reward track (both are available to Subscribers!) and new rewards. 

The Bounty Contract Event will be enabled for the entirety of the season. Players will be meeting up with Kantec Bren of the Bounty Broker Association (BBA) thus kicking off “The Greatest Bounty”. This season will feature the world bosses from the Dark vs Light (DvL) event! Each week will feature one Dark Side and one Light Side world boss.  

[b]Date Night[/b]

Date Night Companion missions are a new narrative feature that debuted with Game Update 7.4.1. Vette and Aric Jorgan missions will be going live with 7.5.1. These weekly Date Night missions will be available to players who are currently in a romance with these characters, and only when the companions are available in the player’s story.

[b]Servers [/b]

All transfer restrictions to the Shae Vizla server have been removed. 

[b]Gearing adjustments[/b]

notes.title: Game Update 7.5 “Desperate Defiance” is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/68e58cba1aac19926f59ed1781cbd3dd6e114070.jpg[/img]

Players can now enjoy all the new content in Game Update 7.5!

[b]Desperate Defiance Story[/b]
7.5 brings the next chapter of the story, “Desperate Defiance.” Padawan Sa’har Kateen asks for help in a risky mission to retrieve Darth Nul’s holocron, turning on Heta Kol, her brother Ri’kan, and the Hidden Chain. Visit the new Minboosa District on Hutta and meet new allies including Adi Vonapa and Rakit, leaders of the worker rebellion. 

[b]Hutta Modernization[/b]
Coming back to Hutta means showing something familiar but also new. The team has been hard at work modernizing many parts of Hutta that not only appear in the Minboosa District, but in the original areas of Hutta as well.

[b]Basilisk Prototype Venture[/b]
A new Venture system is debuting with Game Update 7.5. Players who have fully completed Lane Vizla’s story missions will be introduced to B3-S1, the Basilisk Prototype! Players must work with Lane to help restore the prototype to full functionality. 

[b]Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival [/b]
A new event has been added to SWTOR’s seasonal calendar! The Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival begins with the launch of Game Update 7.5 and will run for 28 days! Players can enjoy a galactic egg hunt, pie baking, dancing, and more! 

[b]PvP Season 6 “Great Pirate Hunt”[/b]
The start of PvP Seasons will now be tied to game updates! The new PvP goes live alongside Game Update 7.5 and will run for 16 weeks (up from 12 weeks). 

[b][i]The Acolyte™[/i] inspired items available in the Cartel Market[/b]
Players will notice a new Inspire By tab has been added to the Cartel Market window. Under this tab, players will find the Dark Harbinger Armor set and Serpent’s Tongue Vibroblade inspired by The Acolyte™. Additionally, a Wookiee Jedi inspired by hairstyle and beard customization can be found as part of the Appearance Options: Loyal Adherent Hairstyles Bundle.    

The full list of patch notes can be found [url=http://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]here[/url].

notes.title: Game Update 7.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Highlights[/h1][/b]

[list]

[/list]

[list][*] There is a 15 million credit cap per character.
[*] Characters must be at least level 20 in order to qualify for a transfer.

[/list][/list]

[*] The “View Ledger” button on the Cartel Market now correctly links to the updated page on the website.

[*] Resolved an issue with the speeders on Hutta where Players would pop or spin around at the end of Taxi Routes.

[*] The Mantellian Flutterplume’s name is now spelled correctly.
[*] Fixed some visual oddities on several waterfalls on Tython.
[*] Removed a random floating bottle on Dantooine.

[*] Z0-0M Should no longer become an invalid companion when re-logging during “Shroud of Memory”.
[*] The player's dark side corruption should no longer be removed when completing The Forgotten World mission.

[*] [DAILY] Unstable Readings" (Both)

[/list]

[*]

[previewyoutube=vCBNVHEdvpo;full][/previewyoutube]

Eric Musco, Lead Game Producer, and Jackie Ko, Community Manager discuss hosting streams more often, and a list of features for the 7.4.1 stream.

Redeem code "[b]LotSKrovos[/b]" [url=https://www.swtor.com/redeem-code]on this page[/url] to get a Darth Krovos Stronghold decoration. Be sure to redeem this deco before February 29th.

[u][b]Timestamp 16:55[/b][/u]

PvP Season 5 "Pirate's Plunder" begins February 27th! Here's a look at the rewards coming in this season.

notes.title: Game Update 7.4 "Chains in the Dark" is now live!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.4, players will experience a never before seen area on Ord Mantell called Kessan’s Landing, obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards in the Daily Area, take on the FR3-D0M World Boss, and more! Details on what players can expect from this new update are below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/db83fd3d7a4f12719afe6324735cbd4f338145e4.png[/img]

[b][u]“Chain in the Dark” storyline[/u][/b]

Kessan’s Landing is a new Daily Area on Ord Mantell. Players will find that they can complete repeatable missions, and obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards. There will also be a chain of side missions that will take players all over the galaxy, allowing them to assemble a piece of tech that will be very useful on Kessan’s Landing.

[u][b]Lane Vizla’s storyline continues on![/b][/u]

Lane Vizla’s story continues in Game Update 7.4 in a series of missions that follows the events of Showdown on Ruhnuk (Game Update 7.2). Throughout these missions, players will be meeting up Lane Vizla herself, an expert in droid history called The Curator, and an assassin droid HK-24 unit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/146567827362cd48d80d0357d509cf5fb097be5f.jpg[/img]

[u][b]New World Boss[/b][/u]

Players are encouraged to mind their feet and keep an eye out for burning patches of plasma that FR3-D0M tends to leave on the ground during combat. There is a chance that FR3-D0M will drop a unique mount called the Mantellian Separatist Hover Turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/50569d684caec9e696630b3831a91f4d680a132b.png[/img]

[u][b]Galactic Trade Network Overhaul[/b][/u]

The GTN is completely rebuilt, making it more accessible but also familiar to players. Players will see a new advanced search section, and a more streamlined flow for claiming and selling items. More information can be found [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931783-74-gtn-preview-live-on-pts/]here[/url]. 

[u][b]Gearing Changes[/b][/u]

All the changes coming to 7.4, can be found in [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931765-gearing-feedback-pts-thread/]this forum post! [/url]

[u][b]Cinematic Lighting updates[/b][/u]

We are activating a new character lighting tool for all cinematic content. Any cinematic content in the game currently - from class stories to world arcs to more recent expansions - will employ this new character lighting system. Some of the highlights of this system include using environment lighting for more accurate shadows, detailed self shadowing on characters, and more custom lighting control in cinematics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/50e2a93cd13f0bd7937d6dad481c41c419bf8e95.png[/img]


[u][b]New to the Cartel Market[/b][/u]

Many offerings are coming to the Cartel Market with Game Update 7.4. Some of which are the Defiant Maverick Armor set (inspired by Sabine Wren) and the Darth Nul Dualsaber. We will be rolling out the new items on a weekly basis, so be sure to check out the Cartel Market to see what new items are available. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d3dd938e0aa7571a05a89391165d17d7d24b3947.png[/img]
(Defiant Maverick Armor inspired by Sabine Wren)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/a7ade6185aaf5cc19975d7c9783c6484a093e579.png[/img]
(Darth Nul Dualsaber)

New enhanced dye packs that utilize specularity (how reflections are used to make a surface appear metallic, pearlescent, or matte) will also be released over time beginning 7.4 launch and these dyes specifically will only be available for a limited time. These dyes will be rotated out on a weekly basis from now until January 6, 2024. They can still be obtained through hypercrates beyond that date. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/1c5576309b67e35df9360c07ef17d3c5fc4576d2.png[/img]
(Various specular dyes on Suppression Trooper Armor set. 
From left to right - default Metallic Black/Pearlescent Red, Metallic Gold / Chrome White, Chrome White / Metallic Gold, Matte Black / Metallic Black)

A full list of Cartel Market items will be posted soon!

[u][b]Life Day[/b][/u]

Life Day is returning and will begin December 12th! Players will be able to obtain a new outfit called the Life Day Officer Armor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2bffd352a350bba304b35565c71f57fcc9ebe635.png[/img]

Be sure to also check out all the other[url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20231129] in-game events, including Double XP, happening in December! [/url]

We'll see you all in game!

notes.title: Game Update 7.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Chains in the Dark Storyline[/b]

Following the showdown between Shae Vizla and Heta Kol in Game Update 7.2, players will be returning to Ord Mantell to explore a small, provincial island called Kessan’s Landing to face the Hidden Chain strike team head on.

[b]New Daily Area[/b]

Kessan’s Landing is a new Daily Area on Ord Mantell. Players will find that they can complete repeatable missions, and obtain new Achievements and Reputation rewards. There will also be a chain of side missions that will take players all over the galaxy, allowing them to assemble a piece of tech that will be very useful on Kessan’s Landing.

[b]New World Boss[/b]

Players are encouraged to mind their feet and keep an eye out for burning patches of plasma that FR3-D0M tends to leave on the ground during combat. There is a chance that FR3-D0M will drop a unique mount called the Mantellian Separatist Hover Turret.

[b]Cinematic Lighting Update[/b]

Beginning in 7.4, we are activating a new character lighting tool for all cinematic content. Any cinematic content in the game currently - from class stories to world arcs to more recent expansions - will employ this new character lighting system. Some of the highlights of this system include using environment lighting for more accurate shadows, detailed self shadowing on characters, and more custom lighting control in cinematics.

[b]Life Day[/b]

The annual celebration is back! Life Day will be celebrated from December 12, 2023 - January 09, 2024 so make sure you hug a Wookiee in celebration!

[b]Galactic Trade Network (GTN)Revamp[/b]

The GTN is completely rebuilt, making it more accessible but also familiar to players. Players will see a new advanced search section, and a more streamlined flow for claiming and selling items. More information can be found here. [url=https://www.google.com/url?q=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931783-74-gtn-preview-live-on-pts/&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1701712408135619&usg=AOvVaw1W8Sr5HU88XxgzDA1Ne6Mz]Forums Link[/url]

[b]Gearing Changes[/b]

The maximum for Item Ratings for gear has been increased. More details can be found here. [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/931765-gearing-feedback-pts-thread/?do=findComment&comment=9785568]Forums Link[/url]

[b]Quick Travel Map[/b]

Multiple fixes were applied to the Quick Travel map including: 
[list]    [*]The quick travel points now appear on the map after the discovery of the area they reside in. The Corellia Tears of Taris, 2 points on Balmorra, the Voss Cantina and the Belsavis Cantina which were previously missing are now visible.[/*]    [*]All quick travel points are accessible after unlocking them.[/*]    [*]All quick travel points will now show on the world map, regardless of location- like behind an elevator.[/*]    [*]Objective tracking is listed on the quest breadcrumbs on the map[/*]    [*]Interacting with NPC vendors no longer shows their name as "Undefined" on the map[/*]    [*]World Map coordinates will now show properly when reaching 4 digits[/*][/list]
[b]Class Balance Changes[/b]
[list]    [*]Sniper / Gunslinger[list]            [*]Engineering / Saboteur[/*]            [*]Reduced the critical damage bonus given to Explosive Probe / Explosive Charge from the Laser Targeting / Sequential Targeting mod to 20% (from 25%).[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Juggernaut / Guardian[list]            [*]Vengeance / Vigilance[list]                    [*]Removing the cooldown reduction from Major Fracture / Cauterizing Brand[/*]                    [*]Fixed an issue with Deep Cuts where it wasn't properly increasing periodic damage critical hit chance[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Powertech / Vanguard[list]            [*]Pyrotech / Plasmatech[list]                    [*]Superheated Fuel now increases Flame attack critical chance and critical hit damage by 25%.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]



[b]General Updates and Fixes[/b]

Corrected an issue preventing SCORPIO from being granted as a companion in KotFE Chapter VII: Lady of Sorrows. We also fixed an issue that would prevent the next chapter from starting automatically.

Commando/Mercenary
[list]    [*]When using a Regeneration toy, Supercharge building stops when the Rest & Recharge abilities are canceled.[/*][/list]
Sentinel/Marauder
[list]    [*]When using a Regeneration toy, Centering/Fury building stops when the Rest & recharge is canceled.[/*][/list]
Meridat Stato (Imperial Fleet Vendor), Nelva Stato (Republic Fleet Vendor) and Felusia Stato (Stronghold Vendor) are now selling the “Simple Merchant Rug” decoration again.

The vendors are now selling only one copy of the Basic Junker's Light.

Players who received the incorrectly named Elite Tactician Blaster Pistol will now be able to use it to unlock the Hermit's Vigil in Collections. To trigger the Collection unlock, players will need to equip the weapon or move it to the cargo hold storage and BACK into their inventory.

PvP Season 2 and 3 items are now properly showing in Giradda the Hutt’s inventory, the PvP Classic vendor.

The Burning Rampage Chestplate will no longer stretch when the character moves their head.

The Empire Director Mantle’s cape will no longer clip with the male body type 4 characters or players’ hands in combat stance

The map notes for the “Hidden Signals” bonus mission now appear properly on the minimap.

The Player can no longer accept both "Peace is a Lie" and "Power through Strength" by claiming the missing mission items from the Collection. Only one of the two missions can exist in the player log at one time.

The words "Weapon Tuning" are added to "Festive Snow Fall" in order to be easier to find on the cartel market.

Loading screen tip has been updated to "A Broadsword or EA employee will never ask you for your password".

The "Advanced Orange-Yellow Crystals” required level to use is now 10, in line with the rest of the color crystals.

The mission-granting items from Galactic Season 5 can now be found in both the “All” category and their own category of the Galactic Season 5 section.

The codex entries for The True Anomaly, The Uxibeast and Weequay Species now have images.

Siege Skytrooper health has been reduced while morphed in a Walker in Season 2: Chapter VIII: End Times on Master Mode. 

The Collapsible Bowcaster Grek is categorized as a Blaster Rifle as per tooltip in Collections.

 Enhanced shadows no longer appears over solid objects such as grates and fences.

 Graphics quality levels adjusted to more closely match the coloration of Ultra.  Low quality level has improved lighting, emissive, and skin shaders and looks closer to the lighting seen in Ultra

 Enhanced shadows adjusted to reduce sparkles and dark halos seen around characters when viewed from a distance.

 NPC and Low graphics settings have improved skin shader and reduced compression artifacts in textures.

 Scrolling cloud shadows enabled in certain areas 

Lieutenant Xorem, the mission giver on Ord Mantell for the mission “Victims of War” is now always visible.

Killing the Geonosian Queen in her Operation also completes the quest associated with the task.

When sheathed the Classic Lightweight Vibrosword sits at the same height as other vibroswords, including the Classic Vibrosword.

Fixed an issue where Imperial characters using Male Body Type 3 could get stuck while completing the Galactic Season objective "Mousecapades" on Alderaan, Taris, and Hoth.

The collision on the stairway in the Cantina on Rishi is adjusted so that all characters of all body types can step over it without jumping.

There is no longer a floating bush in the Appearance Modification Station or anywhere else on the Imperial Fleet.

Plants no longer have unintended holes in their leaves on Alderaan, Hutta and Oricon.

The "Dathomir Rancor" now has a picture in the Cartel Market..

The Space Missions "[HEROIC] Thanium Disruption" and "[HEROIC] Cha Raaba Assault" are now giving credit towards the Galactic Season Objective "We're Not Out of This Yet".

The K-NorCo B5C now has the same flourish as the K-NorCo B5B mount.

There is no longer a difference in appearance of the Empire Director Cowl, Scorching Sands, Shadeveil Warrior and Shadeveil Assassin sets when viewed on your character vs other characters.

The Model Redeemer Starfighter can now be unlocked in Collections.

A few turrets in the Section X area of Belsavis are no longer floating in the air.

The Imperial Banner is no longer clipping with a Sith Statue on the Korriban Arrival Port, because it was removed.

Reduced the reflectivity on some Imperial Walls .

All listed Uprisings count towards the Galactic Season objective "Quelling the Uprising".

It is no longer possible to use a jump shortcut in the Flashpoint: Athiss.

Players can no longer fall through the floor and reach an unintended area in the R-4 Anomaly Operation.

Players who have destroyed the Galactic Season 5 Mission unlocks can now re-purchase them from Jaleit Nall, the Classic and Non-Seasonal Rewards vendor.".

The Hover Light Weapon Tuning now works correctly with Female Body Type 4.

The position of all Jetpack Mounts has been adjusted to fit the characters back on all body types.

Max Bet Chips can now be purchased with Collector's Edition access without needing to purchase the VIP Wristband.

Trees are no longer clipping through the bridge in Darth Baras's Secret Lair.

It is no longer possible to summon ineligible characters to the VIP area on the Fleet.

notes.title: An introduction from Rob Denton + Game Update 7.4 Livestream announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/76c6ac0d84081c83689e32a77816ada1ddbf5fdf.png[/img]

Hi everyone - Rob Denton here, President of Broadsword Online Games. Now that some time has passed, I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself and share some details on Star Wars™: The Old Republic and Broadsword. First off, I'm thrilled that the SWTOR team has joined Broadsword. During my time at BioWare, I worked on the game (and closely with the team) for several years and helped support the 2011 launch, so it's very near to my heart.
 
Keith Kanneg, as the Executive Producer, sets the vision for the game, and he’ll continue to maintain the relationship with Lucasfilm Games and Electronic Arts. Keith and I will work closely together to ensure that SWTOR continues to grow, thrive and be the amazing game that you all love.

I’ll let Keith say more about Game Update 7.4, but I see a very bright future for SWTOR and our plans are already starting to take shape for new and exciting things. I have always been fond of SWTOR, and I look forward to seeing what this amazing team will create and continue to build upon in the years to come.
 
-Rob

Hey folks!

I couldn’t be more pleased working with Rob and the team at Broadsword on and building out future plans for SWTOR and our players. I wanted to take the opportunity to check in with all of you and give an update on where we are with Game Update 7.4. The last couple of months has been incredibly busy with us launching 7.3: Old Wounds and 7.3.1 alongside technology improvements including our migration to cloud game servers. The team has been hard at work getting Game Update 7.4 out the door, and I cannot wait for players to experience the content in it.

I’m pleased to announce that we will be hosting a livestream going over the finer details of the update on October 18th at 1:30pm CT / 6:30pm UTC over on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/swtor]our streaming channel[/url]. During the stream, players will be hearing from a variety of voices, including myself, and will be getting a sneak peek into everything coming in 7.4. 

Very excited for the team to show off what they’ve been working on, and I’m looking forward to seeing all of you very soon. 

May the Force be with you!

-Keith Kanneg, Executive Producer of Star Wars: The Old Republic

notes.title: Game Update 7.3.1 is live!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.3.1, players may begin earning rewards from the Galactic Season 5, “Confidence in Power” and will see UI/UX updates for our overlay and HUD maps.  Details on what players can expect from this new update are below!

[b]Galactic Seasons: Season 5, “Confidence in Power”[/b]

In previous seasons, players embarked on their storyline missions with a new companion. Season 5 introduces a new way to engage with the story told in Galactic Seasons, with story progression now a part of the Galactic Seasons rewards. Players will unlock new story missions as they progress through the reward track, with the final mission granted at Season Level 40. 

We are also adding new objectives that will involve companions being set to specific roles, Space Missions, and Operations. There are more objectives available for players who are Subscribers or have Preferred accounts. All the details can be found [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/20230901-0]here[/url].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f28278afa594254f5b577e28b83baac777a813f9.png[/img]
[i](Decorationss that can be earned from the GS5 reward track or bought from the vendor. From top left to right - Dark Marauder Soldier, Imperial Lieutenant Officer, Wasteland Tech Crackshot, Imperial Reaper Combatant)
(Bottom left to right - Depository of Dark Wisdom, Outer Rim Drifter Gunslinger, 3V-1L, Resilient Warden Gladiator)	[/i]


[b]Mapping improvements[/b]

Players will see various UI/UX improvements to our in-game overlap and HUD maps including: 

[list]
[*] The Quick Travel Ability will no longer open a separate travel map but the world map instead and it will display the Quick Travel points next to your mission objectives. These icons will also be present on the HUD Overlay Map and the Minimap.  
[*] A magnifying cursor has been added 
[*] Travel abilities now show up at the bottom of the overlay map 
[*] Exploration missions have been added to Map Filters
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/2ab920e43f890170e65880250317031df9ed4649.png[/img]
For a full list of improvements, please see the 7.3.1 patch notes found [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]here.[/url]

[b]Balance Changes and Fixes[/b]

Players will also see multiple class changes and fixes across the board updating cooldowns, baseline abilities and more. Details can be found in the patch notes [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes]here[/url]

[b]New to the Cartel Market[/b]

Lightsabers and armor sets inspired by Ahsoka and Grand Admiral Thrawn have been added to the Cartel Market, inspired by Star Wars: Ahsoka on Disney+! New “inspired by” tabs have been added to the Cartel Market window to make it easier for players to find these special items.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7eeb538a1b63c511443ea08fa80c352f706c35f8.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Update 7.3.1 coming soon!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.3.1, players can expect the launch of Galactic Season 5, UI/UX updates for our HUD and world maps, and special weapons and armor sets coming to the Cartel Market. Below is a brief overview of the features coming with this update. More details will be provided at a later time. 

[u][b]Galactic Seasons: Season 5, “Confidence in Power”[/b][/u]

The new Galactic Season will begin with the launch of 7.3.1, so players will be able to immediately progress through the new reward track. Season 5 introduces a new way to engage with the story told in Galactic Seasons. Rather than tying narrative progression to companion influence, story progression is now part of the Galactic Seasons rewards track. Players will unlock new story missions as they progress through the reward track, with the final mission granted at Season Level 40. Additionally, instead of receiving a new companion, players will interact with several new characters, like an oddly enthusiastic astromech named 3V-1L, while making dialogue choices that affect gameplay. Under the command of a mysterious Master, 3V-1L will test the player through a series of trials, to see if they are worthy of the Master’s teachings of the “dark side”. Whether this is a prank or a serious threat, the player must decide how deeply they will commit to these “dark” trials to uncover the truth.

We are also adding new objectives that will involve companions being set to specific roles, Space Missions, and Operations. There are more objectives available for players who are Subscribers or have Preferred accounts. More details will be shared at a later time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f62bf4ae69d044019d53f38608b0b6aa99b0a560.jpg[/img]
(3V-1L pictured above)

[u][b]Mapping improvements[/b][/u]

Players will see UI/UX improvements to our HUD and World Maps. Most notably, we’ve improved the quick travel (QT) flow to be more informative. The QT Ability will no longer open a separate travel map but the world map instead and it will display the QT points next to your mission objectives. These icons will also be present on the HUD Overlay Map and the Minimap.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/82860a3a78deef6f6bd8cd72518c17440d8baf4a.png[/img]

There are a number of other UI/UX improvements that were made and they will be covered when we publish the 7.3.1 patch notes! 
 
Additionally, we will be adding a host of exciting new offerings to the Cartel Market! Keep an eye out for more details in an upcoming Cartel Market article.

Game Update 7.3.1 will be launching late August/early September! More details on the content above and the exact release date will follow in the coming weeks, so stay informed by keeping an eye on our forums and social channels.

notes.title: Studio update on Star Wars: The Old Republic
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

I’ve been a part of SWTOR since well before launch and it’s been an incredible journey. I ended up taking on many different roles on the team over that time, so I’ve seen this game from just about every different angle there is. And honestly, I absolutely love this game—not to mention the people who continue to make it fun. Even after almost 12 years, I see so much room for growth and so much potential in SWTOR.

I know decisions that impact our people are the hardest part of change and evolution, but I believe Broadsword is the right studio to continue to enhance and modernize our game—and also expand the number of people who can play it.

Of course, I’m also very glad that I’ll be moving over with key team leaders and continuing to work with most of our current team. This team has never stopped excelling, even proudly delivering an amazing update [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20221213-0]7.2 Showdown on Ruhnuk [/url]over the holiday break—along with technological improvements like our new fast launcher, [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20230328-0]64-bit client[/url] , and Cloud Game Servers. I can’t thank them enough for their passion and dedication in bringing these experiences to life for our players.

I also want to thank EA and BioWare for all they have done for me and this team, not to mention all our friends at Lucasfilm Games, whose support and collaboration have helped make all this happen for us. They’re the best, and I look forward to continuing to work with them.

We are excited about the future of SWTOR, and once we get our feet firmly planted at Broadsword, we look forward to sharing plans for game direction and improvements. Until then, rest assured that all the current plans are still in motion!

As examples, we just delivered our largest story update in months, and a new story flashpoint with [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20230613]Game Update 7.3: Old Wounds[/url], taking us back to the planet Voss, which we haven’t visited since our KOTET expansion back in 2016. We will also be rolling out Game Update 7.3.1, which will contain our next Galactic Season, in the coming months. And stay tuned for details on Game Update 7.4, where players will see the story continue following the events of Old Wounds. And there’s even more on the horizon. We will continue to publish communication on swtor.com and the SWTOR forums, as we always have, so you will be hearing from me again soon.

No change is easy, but it certainly helps that we’re all excited about the future of this very special game. We look forward to seeing that vision become reality alongside all our players and fans.

May the Force be with you,

Keith Kanneg
Executive Producer, Star Wars™: The Old Republic™

notes.title: Game Update 7.3 “Old Wounds” is live!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.3, players will return to Voss and explore an unseen landing zone called Interpreter’s Retreat. Within this new area, players will have the opportunity to experience the new Shrine of Silence Flashpoint. Here is a breakdown of the content players can experience with this new game update!

[u][b]Story Update - “Old Wounds”[/b][/u]
With Darth Nul’s holocron in the Hidden Chain’s possession, players and their allies reinforce their investigations into the ancient Sith’s past. As new information is revealed, so are unexpected truths.

This story update also returns players to the planet Voss where they will join the “Shrine Restoration Initiative” in rebuilding the damage caused by the Eternal Empire’s invasion. Alongside Voss and Gormak members of the Initiative, players will explore the Interpreter’s Retreat, a previously unseen landing zone with new side Missions and Achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/bbc9d9c82a2b88d2f700e4b9dcb25889f19a3662.png[/img]

[u][b]New Flashpoint: “Shrine of Silence”[/b][/u]
In this new Flashpoint, players will assist a Voss Commando by rescuing two Mystics who disappeared in the perilous ruins of the Shrine of Silence. By completing this Flashpoint, players will be able to earn new armor sets and new Stronghold decorations. 

“Shrine of Silence” is available in all modes and can be completed Solo or with a group. The flashpoint is related to the story in the Interpreter’s Retreat, but it will not be required to complete the new story content on Voss. 

[u][b]Credit Economy Initiative[/b][/u]
Announced during our 7.3 livestream and in the following forum post: [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/929143-73-credit-economy-initiative-updates-and-the-gtn/]7.3 Credit Economy Initiative: Updates and the GTN[/url], we’ve made additional changes to the Credit Economy, including retiring the Tax Evasion Guild Perk, adding a new transaction fee, and adjusting Vendor sale values on many items. 

[u][b]Progression changes[/b][/u]
To reduce the complexity of Gear Progression, we’ve removed the Daily Resource Matrices. Players will now receive Conquest Commendations when completing Daily and Heroic Missions. Additionally, we’ve made changes to weekly and total caps of several currencies. More details can be found here: [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/929217-progression-changes-coming-in-73/#comment-9756002]Progression Changes coming in 7.3[/url].

[u][b]Combat changes[/b][/u]
This new update also brings balance changes. More information in the Combat Styles section of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3664288067559844593]7.3 patch notes[/url].

[u][b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife[/b][/u]
The Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event is back! From July 11th (12:00 pm GMT) until August 22nd 2023 (12:00 pm GMT), players can test their luck at one of our casinos and earn new rewards inspired by the High Roller Shades. Here are the new rewards players can obtain:
[list]
[*] High Roller Skiff Mount (available on Emperor’s Grace Machine)
[*] High Roller Armor Set Box (available on Emperor’s Grace Machine) 
[*] High Roller Armor individual pieces (available on vendor)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/bba2dc201366df410be37c1131d120000fd2a960.png[/img]
High Roller Skiff Mount.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/594c51dff51c91aca5972cfbb94f996c64302f9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9060d58535a2ef8a11b51a6cfafb883eed49e389.png[/img]
High Roller Armor Set.

[u][b]PvP Season 3 “Reign of Glory”[/b][/u]
The new PvP Season starts on July 18th! This new season brings changes to PvP maps, as well as new decorations and armor sets, like the Sandstorm Soldier Armor Set. More details about the changes in this forum post (only available in English) and in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3664288067559844593]7.3 patch notes[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9f2db0adfd243f66bcc7798cfa01f800075266e9.png[/img]

notes.title: Content from Game Update 7.3: Old Wounds is coming to the Public Test Server!
notes.notes:
We recently hosted the Game Update 7.3: Old Wounds livestream yesterday on our 
Twitch channel. The full recap can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3700313694053436131]here[/url].

The Public Test Server (PTS) is now open for players to check out the following content:

[u][b]The Interpreter’s Retreat[/b][/u]
Players will be returning to Voss and will be able to explore a brand new area. This new landing zone is called the Interpreter’s Retreat.

The following will be available for players to test:
[list]
[*] Side Missions
[*] Achievements
[*] New Voss-themed rewards
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/18bfe86a9cb992c015d5754bf37982865a0cb293.png[/img]

[u][b]Shrine of Silence Flashpoint[/b][/u]
A Voss Commando seeks help in rescuing two Mystics who disappeared in the perilous ruins of the Shrine of Silence, a mysterious place that many Voss consider to be “cursed”.

The following will be available for players to test:
[list]
[*] Story Mode
[*] Veteran Mode
[*] Master Mode
[*] Each will include three bosses and a bonus boss
[/list]
This Flashpoint can be completed solo or with a group!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b0142627da1cfdfaf7da3d99aa7962322dee7782.png[/img]

As always, story content will not be available on the PTS to keep the player experience spoiler free!

We have [url=https://forums.swtor.com/forum/143-public-test-server/]multiple threads set up[/url] so that players will be able to offer their feedback and report any bugs they may experience while on the PTS.

Additionally, we encourage players to read through and leave feedback on the following posts as these changes will be implemented with Game Update 7.3: 
[list]
[*] Class Balance Changes
[*] Credit Economy Changes
[/list]

We look forward to reading your feedback!

For details on how to access PTS, read [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/868200-getting-started-on-the-pts/]here[/url].

**Please note that PTS is provided in English only.

notes.title: Game Update 7.3 “Old Wounds” Livestream recap
notes.notes:
If you were unable to watch-or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.3 Livestream-we’ve got you covered! Below is a breakdown of what we showed, including timestamps for the different segments of our livestream.

[previewyoutube=xsdqJWnG-yY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][u]Timestamp 05:08[/u][/b]
To celebrate the upcoming launch of Game Update 7.3, “Old Wounds,” use the code LotsSahar on the following [url=https://www.swtor.com/redeem-code]page[/url] to get your own Sa’har Stronghold decoration. Don’t wait too long as this code will only be redeemable until May 18, 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/3486f5d2d4a3637b5e2230ae11b301e92833aadf.png[/img]

[b][u]Timestamp 07:35[/u][/b]
Narrative Director, Ashley Ruhl, and Lead Writer, Caitlin Sullivan Kelly talk about the new Old Wounds storyline and the story of a new Flashpoint called the “Shrine of Silence”. Players will be returning to Voss and explore a new area called the Interpreter’s Retreat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/1bd99840e73bb72169e647b2293d6ea0db4bf442.png[/img]
[i]Interpreter's Retreat.[/i]

[i]Shrine of Silence Flashpoint.[/i]

[b][u]Timestamp 21:28[/u][/b]
Encounter Designer, Daniel Cefaratti, talks about the first boss players will encounter in the “Shrine of Silence”, the Corrupted Vorantikus. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/67cf3c05fd08c28a2d8eb230100a34b1867d3ab7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/69b0b04c25f3e56c6d6d982447466bd2b7412a96.jpg[/img]
[i]Corrupted Vorantikus.[/i]

[b][u]Timestamp 23:05[/u][/b]
Encounter Designer, Victoria McCreary, and Community Manager, Jackie Ko reveal the final boss players will encounter in the Shrine of Silence” Flashpoint called The Curse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/18d2b6befa003c935a67d0b856b062eab2856fc4.png[/img]
[i]The Curse (Concept).[/i]

[b][u]Timestamp 28:00[/u][/b]
Lead Game Producer, Eric Musco and Gameplay Designer, Shabir Dhillon, talk about PvP changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9f2db0adfd243f66bcc7798cfa01f800075266e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/136a4d9c269eb0901d96a15e8235ed0d148c3a56.png[/img]
[i]Sandstorm Soldier Armor Set.[/i]

[b][u]Timestamp 34:19[/u][/b]
System Designer, Joe Stramaglia, gives more insight on the credit economy initiative such as new taxes, additional features on the GTN, and a new commodity order system.

Players got a sneak peek of 7.3 Cartel Market items and rewards that can be obtained during the Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event.

notes.title: Game Update 7.2.1 is live!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.2.1, players may begin earning rewards from the Galactic Season 4 and PvP Season 2 Reward tracks! We’re also introducing a new 64-bit Game Client and a few changes to combat inflation. Details on what players can expect from this new update are below! 

[u][b]Galactic Seasons: Season 4, “A Passage of Peace”[/b][/u]
This update marks the beginning of Galactic Season 4 “A Passage of Peace.” In this season, players are joined by Amity, a Force user on a pilgrimage, as they progress through the Messengers of the Cold Moon reputation track and earn new rewards, including the brand new Mek-Sha Hideout Stronghold! More details on this new companion, rewards, and objectives here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/5ff20414db6a9946b521450c3688a445c47de369.jpg[/img]

[u][b]PvP Seasons: Season 2, “Piercing the Veil”[/b][/u]
The new PvP Season, “Piercing the Veil,” also starts with the launch of Game Update 7.2.1.

To improve players’ experiences, we’ve made a few changes to how Attacker and Defender medals are earned in a match. More details can be found in this forum post (only available in English). Similar to the previous season, players can earn new rewards by earning PvP points and progressing through the PvP Rewards track. More details in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3699183438995464741]PvP Seasons 2 article[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/9c41ed3a518deba7668705f6fe7474c5e921ce6c.png[/img]
[i]From left to right: Shadowfiend Armor Set, Shadeveil Assassin’s Armor Set.[/i]

[u][b]Credit Economy Initiative[/b][/u]
With Game Update 7.2.1, we’re also introducing changes to correct some of our economic inflation. More details about these changes can be found in this [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/927608-credit-economy-initiative-beginning-with-721/]forum post[/url]. These changes are the first of multiple updates we’ll make in future releases throughout the year. Keep an eye on our social platforms and our website for more updates regarding this topic.

[u][b]64-bit Game Client[/b][/u]
Following the Public Test Server sessions, we’re now deploying the 64-bit Game Client to all players! With this migration, players can use more memory and are no longer limited to 4 GB per process. This update also helps the team streamline the process of building compelling content for the coming years. More details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3632751459976319454]here[/url]. 

Here are the new system requirements (also known as “min specs”): 
[list]
[*] [b]OS:[/b] Windows 10 or later
[*] [b]Processor AMD:[/b] Athlon 64 X2 Dual-Core 4000+ or better
[*] [b]Processor Intel:[/b] Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0GHz or better
[*] [b]Memory:[/b] 6 GB RAM
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Star Wars: The Old Republic requires a video card that has a minimum of 1 GB of on-board RAM as well as support for Shader 3.0 or better. 
[list]
[*] Examples include:Intel HD 3000 or better/AMD Radeon HD 7450/Nvidia GeForce 610
[/list]
[*] [b]Storage:[/b] 75 GB available space
[*] [b]Internet connection[/b] Required to play
[/list]

Alongside the 64-bit client, players should expect to see graphics setting changes coming to this update. With 7.2.1, the game will now be able to detect the best graphics setting on your machine. If a player’s machine contains more than one card, the game will choose the card that will provide the most optimized visuals. In short, on the first run after downloading 7.2.1, the game will re-select the graphics quality level based on the player’s GPU specs.

Other changes include: 
[list]
[*] The game will automatically boot up in full screen windowed mode. This can be changed to the player’s preference in settings. 
[*] The “Very Low” Graphic Quality Preset will be removed from the game entirely as it has now become obsolete with our new tech updates. 
[*] For players who use laptops, the game will now default to using your dedicated GPU.
[*] The frame rate limiter has been fixed so players can request the max FPS through the graphics settings.
[/list]

The full list of patch notes for this update is available [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3692428773815856998]here[/url].

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7f70dc3750d7d1a8cf2b0c0d8608adb934e1a595.png[/img]

Back in December of 2022 we opened our Public Test Server (PTS) and invited players to check out Star Wars: The Old Republic in 64-bit. A 64-bit client along with a host of other content is coming soon when 7.2.1 launches and players are going to get the chance to test out even more of it soon. Let’s dive in and walk you through everything that is coming in the Update, and what will be available for testing.

[u][b]Galactic Season 4 - A Passage of Peace[/b][/u]
7.2.1 will mark the beginning of the next Galactic Season - A Passage of Peace. Like previous Seasons, this one will come with a host of new rewards players can earn and will feature a brand new companion, Amity, for players to learn and traverse the galaxy with. Stay tuned for more details on this season and a sneak peek at its rewards!

One new reward we are thrilled to share is that players will be able to use their Galactic Seasons Tokens to purchase a brand new apartment Stronghold on the planet of Mek-sha. The Mek-sha Hideout Stronghold is similar in size and scale to the seasonal Fleet Strongholds.

[u][b]PvP Season 2[/b][/u]
As a reminder our inaugural PvP season post-revamp will run until the end of February  . Players can then look forward to Season 2 starting with the launch of 7.2.1 where they can earn all new rewards! Similar to Galactic Seasons, stay tuned in the coming weeks as we begin to reveal what these new rewards will be.

We have been actively monitoring your feedback on PvP following our revamp in 7.2 and we are exploring a variety of changes. The first among those are some changes to Attacker and Defender medals which we are testing with the Alderaan Warzone. More on that in the PTS section below.

[u][b]Combating Inflation[/b][/u]
As many longtime players will likely recognize, the credit economy in SWTOR has had some pretty substantial inflation over the years. This makes it challenging for players to engage in our trade economy, especially new players. One of our goals this year is to begin correcting some of our economic inflation. We have a couple of initiatives which will begin in 7.2.1 and expect more changes in future releases throughout the year. More details in the PTS section below.

[u][b]64-bit Testing[/b][/u]
7.2.1 will also mark the release of our 64-bit client and although we have been testing this on PTS since December of last year, we encourage players to continue logging in and letting us know of any issues they experience. 

We encourage players to log into the Public Test Server and report any issues they may experience. It is vital to gather as much information as possible during this testing phase as there are thousands of permutations of processor, memory, graphics card, etc… that exist for PC gaming. Knowing how certain configurations perform with the game is crucial. Please play as you normally would, and if there is anything strange happening, let us know about it! 

[u][b]PTS[/b][/u]
Now that players know what to expect in Game Update 7.2.1, what exactly will be available for testing on PTS?
[list]
[*] In the Alderaan Warzone, players will now earn Attacker and Defender points when defeating enemies near Objectives. Check out more details in our feedback thread here.
[*] 7.2.1’s PTS is our new 64-bit client so please login and let us know of any issues you experience with your natural play, here.
[*] We are making some changes to credit costs to account for inflation. Full details in the feedback thread here.
[*] Devs will also be participating in PvP matches on [u][b]Friday, February 10th at 1:30pm CT[/b][/u] to test these changes alongside players.
[/list] 

During this phase of PTS, we will be granting an Opal Vulptilla Mount to players who complete the following tasks:
[list]
[*] Log onto the PTS
[*] Complete a Warzone match
[/list]
This reward will be distributed with the launch of Game Update 7.2.1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/f17bd6e59723a31edce30275e912e2f5ca5c778b.jpg[/img]

We look forward to seeing everyone on the PTS! 
  
*Content on the PTS is available only in English.

notes.title: Game Update 7.2 “Showdown on Ruhnuk” is live!
notes.notes:
Game Update 7.2 brings plenty of new content to the game. Players will be able to explore a new planet, Ruhnuk, fight Heta Kol and her faction of Mandalorians in the story update “Showdown on Ruhnuk,” experience the changes made to PvP, and more! Let’s dive into the details of what players can expect with this new game update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e1aa2a376cc208941f56898d99e4f5f30eba3a3d.jpg[/img]

[b]Story Update - “Showdown on Ruhnuk”[/b]
In this new story update, “Showdown on Ruhnuk,” players help Shae Vizla in her hunt for Heta Kol, a rogue Mandalorian who has gathered an army of rebels under the banner of the Hidden Chain. This pursuit brings them to Ruhnuk, an inhospitable planet at the center of an electrical nebula.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/bba421f453858e93cdcb722fa71fb1e24def41d5.jpg[/img]

[b]New planet - Ruhnuk[/b]
This new planet–a dry, arid, and plateau-based world–was originally occupied to mine its various resources. The planet, now abandoned, is Heta Kol’s base of operations.

[b]Ruhnuk Daily Area[/b]
Explore Ruhnuk in our new Daily Area! Alongside Mandalorian Lane Vizla, expand your faction’s influence with all new weekly and daily Missions, Achievements, and a Reputation Track, and unlock new rewards and titles.

[b]User Interface Enhancements[/b]
To improve players’ experience in our game, we’ve made updates to the UI! Some of the changes and improvements include adding visual updates to our Welcome Window and more customization for the utility bar, a new deconstruct and delete window, a Colorblind Mode UI, and Map System Revamp! Jump into the game to check out these improvements. 

[b]Gearing changes[/b]
In addition to the new content described above, we’re bringing changes to gearing with new item ceilings and new item floors. Details in this forum post: [url=https://forums.swtor.com/topic/925879-gear-and-progression-changes-coming-with-72/]Gear and progression changes coming with 7.2[/url].

[b]PvP Revamp[/b]
Game Update 7.2 brings changes to PvP Mode! There is no longer any distinction between Unranked and Ranked PvP. Players will now queue solo or as a group for 4v4 or 8v8 matches. 
Our first PvP Season is starting now with a new PvP Map, “Onderon Palatial Ruins!” Jump into the game to complete PvP content and earn PvP points from our new PvP Reward Track! More details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3642879552262575275]here[/url]. 

[b]Life Day Celebration[/b]
Our Life Day celebration starts now and runs until January 10th! It’s the time of the year to throw snowballs at your friends to complete Conquest Objectives and Achievements and earn festive rewards. For the new edition of the event, we’re introducing new rewards, such as a new Gala Hat and new snowglobes themed around the R-4 Anomaly, Manaan, Ruhnuk, and Elom. 

[b]Best view in SWTOR 2022[/b]
Contest-winning decorations are now available at the “Anniversary Personnel” vendor on the Fleet! Winners will receive their own decorations in their in-game mail. Check the ten winners [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1286830/announcements/detail/3642879484779229719]here[/url].  

[b]Eleven-Year Anniversary[/b]
To celebrate The Old Republic’s Eleven-Year Anniversary, Coruscant and Kaas City Strongholds can be purchased at a discounted price of eleven credits until the launch of our next game update. 

Log in to the game now to experience the new content and changes. The full list of patch notes for this update is available here.

notes.title: PvP Revamp with Game Update 7.2
notes.notes:
Here’s all you need to know about the Arena and Warzones PvP changes that are coming to Game Update 7.2 “Showdown on Ruhnuk.” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/d6e47e8cb60543e101caf70df9bce763a786a9a1.png[/img]

[b][u]The goals for the PvP Revamp[/u][/b]
Our goal is to create a positive and engaging PvP experience for all players by increasing the overall participation and quality of PvP matches and offering new incentives that benefit everyone who participates in PvP. 

[b][u]What are the changes?[/u][/b]
No distinction between Ranked and Unranked play
Previously, players would queue for Warzones and Arenas in Unranked and Ranked matches. With 7.2, these queues will now be consolidated. Players will be able to queue solo or as a group for 4v4 or 8v8 matches. Additionally, with 7.2, the 8v8 queue will also allow full 8-player premade groups to queue up.  

[u]No restrictions for non-subscribers[/u]
All players, regardless of account type, can participate in PvP. During previous seasons, non-subscribers were restricted on the amount of matches they could play. With 7.2, free-to-play accounts will be able to participate in PvP; however, they will earn PvP points at a slower pace than Subscribers. 

[u]New PvP Points system[/u]
Players will now earn PvP points by playing and completing PvP content. These points will be based on three criteria:
[list]
[*]Types of match
[*]Win/loss
[*]Amount of medals earned during the match. Medals have been updated to accurately reflect the state of damage numbers in 7.0. Players will need to earn 8 medals in a match to get full rewards. 
[*]Note that points are only earned through participation in Arenas and Warzones, this does not include Galactic Star Fighter.
[/list]

Below are the details on how many points players can get from participating in Warzones:

[center][b]Warzone[/b][/center]
[table]
[tr][td][/td][td]Warzone Win[/td][td]Warzone Loss[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]8 or more medals[/td][td]24[/td][td]8[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]7 medals[/td][td]21[/td][td]7[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]6 medals[/td][td]18[/td][td]6[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]5 medals[/td][td]15[/td][td]5[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]4 medals[/td][td]12[/td][td]4[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]3 medals[/td][td]9[/td][td]3[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]2 medals[/td][td]6[/td][td]2[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]1 medals[/td][td]3[/td][td]1[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]0 medals[/td][td]0[/td][td]0[/td][/tr]
[/table]

In addition to the above, players can earn bonus points with the Warzone “queued as group” bonus. This bonus will grant 2 PvP Points, assuming players meet the minimum medal threshold of 6.

[center][b]Arena[/b][/center]
[table]
[tr][td][/td][td]Arena Win[/td][td]Arena Loss[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]8 or more medals[/td][td]12[/td][td]4[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]7 medals[/td][td]10[/td][td]3[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]6 medals[/td][td]9[/td][td]3[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]5 medals[/td][td]8[/td][td]3[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]4 medals[/td][td]6[/td][td]2[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]3 medals[/td][td]4[/td][td]2[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]2 medals[/td][td]3[/td][td]1[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]1 medals[/td][td]2[/td][td]1[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]0 medals[/td][td]0[/td][td]0[/td][/tr]
[/table]

Similar to the Warzone bonus, players can get an Arena “queued as group” bonus of 1 PvP Point, assuming they meet the minimum medal threshold of 6.

Finally, players will be able to earn PvP points by completing PvP Season Objectives. 
Each week, players will have 4 PvP Season Objectives (Subscribers will have 6 PvP Season Objectives) that award 100 PvP Points each when completed. Players will only be able to complete 4 of these objectives per week, regardless of their account type.

[u]New PvP Rewards track[/u]
A new PvP rewards track will be added to the same window where players can find the Galactic Seasons track. 

On this tab, players will be able to track the PvP Season Objectives and their progression through the current PvP Season. Players will be able to see their level, the number of PvP points earned for the week, including the overall total of points accumulated. 

Each PvP season, players will be able to advance through 25 levels that grant rewards such as Armor Sets, Seasonal Trophies decorations (small and large), titles, and more. The team is targeting to have several PvP Seasons per calendar year, with each season running for 12 weeks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7ff6f6b2c2a3d0966d4f4706d011df6c7c67d8ce.png[/img]
[i](Seasonal Trophies decorations (large and small). Colors can be changed to white, blue, or red.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b09eae38a98f444bb65ca2b43f4884275b33f7dc.png[/img]
[i](From left to right: Cartel Prospect's and Combatant's Armor Sets.)[/i]

Similar to Galactic Seasons, players will have the opportunity to catch up on rewards from Week 7 of the PvP Season. Credits can only be used to catch up to level 15.  

[u]Ranked PvP Tokens[/u]
Players who still own Ranked PvP Tokens earned during the previous seasons will need to spend these tokens before 7.2 as they will be removed when the update goes live. The tokens will not be converted into any other form of currency.  

The items that could be purchased by these Ranked PvP Tokens will be available on the seasonal PvP vendor, however, the rate that players will be earning the new PvP currency will only allow them to purchase either new items or one to two replicas. If a player who was not previously engaged in Ranked PvP focused all of their efforts into obtaining these replicas and none of the new items, it would take several years to obtain every single one.  

[u]PvP Vendors[/u]
You can find the PvP Vendors, Giradda the Hutt and Tullek, on the Fleet of each faction. Players will be able to purchase items with PvP Season Tokens received from the new PvP Season Reward Track. 

Current Season rewards will be available on the PvP Seasonal vendor Tullek’s inventory during the entire season. When the season ends, these rewards will be moved to Giradda’s inventory.

The PvP Rewards Vendor, Giradda the Hutt, will offer replicas, trophy decorations, titles, and art decoration of Arenas and Warzones on a rotating basis. 

Giradda’s inventory rotation will work similarly to the Galactic Seasons vendor Jaleit Nall’s inventory rotation. We will have 4 rotation groups: A, B, C, and D. Each Rotation Group will be active for 1 week and then cycle out for 3 weeks. These weekly rotations will occur during our weekly reset at 12:00 PM GMT.

notes.title: Game Update 7.2 “Showdown on Ruhnuk” Livestream Recap
notes.notes:
If you were unable to watch–or if you want a recap of everything we showed during our Game Update 7.2 Livestream–we’ve got you covered! Below is a breakdown of what we showed, including timestamps for the different segments of our livestream.

[previewyoutube=-fY5aLx5HVk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Timestamp 03:16[/b]

To celebrate the upcoming launch of Game Update 7.2, “Showdown on Ruhnuk,” use the code LotSGallore on this page to get your own Colonel Gallo Stronghold decoration. Don’t wait too long, as this code will only be available until November 16th, 2022!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/ce953f274f98c2b395d1ad5316aaf05f5212ca1a.png[/img]

[b]Timestamp 05:12[/b]

Narrative Director, Ashley Ruhl, and Senior Environment Artist, Robby Lamb, introduced the new planet, Ruhnuk, and shared a teaser of the Story Update, “Showdown on Ruhnuk.”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/e4abbc2ef6fe20cdcd17524d8cf356ba6c4ab5ae.jpg[/img]

[b]Timestamp 09:19[/b]

Senior Game Writer, Jay Watamaniuk, gives an overview of all the characters–both enemies and allies–players will meet in “Showdown on Ruhnuk,” including some familiar faces.

[b]Timestamp 14:18[/b]

Lead Writer, Caitlin Sullivan Kelly presents the Ruhnuk Daily Area Story, including new characters Lane Vizla and Kur Ha’rangir. She also gave an overview of the new Reputation Track and rewards players can obtain from it.

[b]Timestamp 24:31[/b]

Lead Game Producer, Eric Musco, and Community Manager, Jackie Ko, talked about the updates that are coming to PvP, such as changes to PvP queues, removing the distinction between Unranked and Ranked modes, the PvP reward track, rewards, and the new “Onderon Palatial Ruins” Map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/fca123e2a554504cc8651bfbf5580ad6f248b73e.png[/img]
(From left to right: Cartel Delegate's and Enforcer's Armor Sets.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b09eae38a98f444bb65ca2b43f4884275b33f7dc.png[/img]
(From left to right: Cartel Prospect's and Combatant's Armor Sets.)

[b]Timestamp 37:35[/b]

Systems Designer, Bryant Wood, discussed gearing changes we’re bringing with Game Update 7.2. We invite you to join us on the forums to give your feedback on gearing in the R-4 Anomaly Operation and to get more details on gearing changes, such as new Legendary Implants, Currency Conversions, and QoL improvements.

[b]Timestamp 39:37[/b]

Game Update 7.2 will also have UI/UX updates, such as a colorblind mode, improved maps, updated tooltips, a new Welcome Window/Top Utility bar, and a customizable Utility Bar.

[b]Timestamp 50:55[/b]

Players got a sneak peek of 7.2 Cartel Market Items with Art Monetization Director, Bradley Lewis. Among the new items, players will be able to purchase the Master Orr’s Lightsaber, the Ceremonial Beskad Blade, the Ri’Kan’s Vibro Axe, and items inspired by The Book of Boba Fett, such as the Pyke Syndicate’s Armor Set.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/7328dd7240d9013137ac509871e418086cdbe9f4.jpg[/img]
(Master Orr’s Lightsaber.)

Timestamp 55:55

We’ve also announced the return of the Life Day Event with new snowglobes themed around the R-4 Anomaly, Manaan, Ruhnuk, and Elom. Get ready to throw snowballs and hug wookies beginning with 7.2's launch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/c16f08e92515a0755d6b5afbf3e8a3477377d3d0.png[/img]
(From left to right: Snowglobes themed around R-4 Anomaly, Manaan, Ruhnuk, and Elom.)


Players will be able to jump into the Public Test Server right now to experience new 7.2 content. Check out the PTS sub-forums here for more details.

Game Update 7.2, “Showdown on Ruhnuk,” launches free to all subscribers in Winter! Keep an eye on our social platforms and website for more updates!

notes.title: Game Update 7.1 “Digging Deeper” is live!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.1 “Digging Deeper,” players return to Elom to unearth new clues about Darth Malgus’s mysterious plans. This update also brings a new Operation–the R-4 Anomaly–as well as the Manaan Daily Area and new tactical items. Alongside the new content, we’ve improved the player’s experience with changes made to the User Interface, including additional customization options. Read below for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/653dd55f9f6b4ced55cee31d503603df68ff924f.png[/img]

[b]Story Update: Digging Deeper[/b] - Discover new secrets about the motivation behind Darth Malgus’s mysterious plans and learn the fate of Sa’har Kateen, the Jedi Padawan Malgus dueled in the ancient ruins of Elom.

[b]R-4 Anomaly Operation[/b] - In this new 8-player Operation, players take on an obscure Sith cult set on harvesting technology from an ancient weapon of terrifying power. This new operation is available in Story Mode and Veteran Mode to all characters at level 80. Look for it in the Activity Finder window!

The following can be obtained from this Operation:
[list]
[*] Virulent Armor Sets
[*] Hazardous Armor Sets
[*] Bosses and R-4 Anomaly Operation Decorations
[*] Item Rating 340 gear in Veteran Mode
[/list]
[b]Manaan Daily Area[/b] - Travel to Manaan for two new, faction-based storylines and repeatable Missions. To access these Missions, characters must have completed the Onslaught and Legacy of the Sith expansions. Manaan Daily Area Missions will be available on the Daily Missions Terminal on Manaan or in the Activity Finder window.

Like other Daily Areas, Manaan will offer several new rewards. To earn them you’ll need to reach the appropriate reputation rank with your respective faction by completing Daily and Weekly Missions. Each faction has a vendor in their base who sells items, including:
[list]
[*] Firaxan Weapon Sets
[*] Manaan Defender and Nightlight Armor Sets
[*] Cerulean Turtle Minipet
[*] Manaan-inspired Stronghold Decorations
[/list]
[b]Four new tacticals[/b] - With this new update, new Tactical items are now available at the vendors in the Supplies section of each Fleet:
[list]
[*] Bodyguard Mercenary / Combat Medic Commando: [b]Kolto Vapors[/b]
[*] Carnage Marauder / Combat Sentinel: [b]Shard of Mortis[/b]
[*] Arsenal Mercenary / Gunnery Commando: [b]Gyroscopic Stabilizers[/b]
[*] Innovative Ordnance Mercenary / Assault Specialist Commando: [b]Magnetic Resonance[/b]
[/list]
[b]Power Increase[/b] - New Items Ratings of gear have been added to Upgrade Vendors on the Fleet. Players can now upgrade to Item Rating 330 by completing Conquests, Flashpoints, and Legacy Operations.

[b]Improved Player Experience [/b]- In addition to the new content listed above, this update also includes Class balance changes, improvements to the Character and Chat windows, and customizable subtitles and combat styles icons.

[b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife 2022[/b] - The Nar Shaddaa Nightlife event is back from August 2nd at 12:00 PM UTC until September 13th at 12:00 PM UTC. For this new edition, we’re introducing new rewards inspired by last year’s High Roller Shades and more! Check these out here.



Log in to the game now to experience the new content and changes. The full list of patch notes for this update is available here.

Players got a sneak peek of rewards they can earn when completing missions in the new Manaan Daily Area. Amongst the new rewards, players can earn Firaxan Weapon Sets, Manaan Defender and Nightlight Armor Sets, and Manaan-inspired decos.

[i]Special note: Players must complete the crit path for Legacy of the Sith in order to access the Manaan Daily Area.[/i]

[b]Timestamp: 31:50[/b]

We’ve also announced the return of Nar Shaddaa Nightlife! This year’s event is scheduled with the launch of Game Update 7.1 and will be live on August 2nd and will run until September 13! Players will have the opportunity to earn new rewards inspired by last year’s High Roller Shades such as the High Roller Weapons. We’ve made slight adjustments to the slot machines in that the frequency of earning currency has been decreased, so the chances of getting items is increased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/b914e7b992963aa7c267373d6e99117ba1473df4.jpg[/img]

[b]Timestamp: 36:40[/b]

The stream wrapped with closing notes from Charles Boyd who offered a glimpse of the future of SWTOR which includes more story, additional features for Outfitter, Flashpoints, the PvP Revamp, and even a completely brand new planet called Ruhnuk.

“I can’t thank you enough from the bottom of my heart. It’s been such a great ride and such an honor to be a part of all this. Thank you all so much for playing SWTOR, thank you all so much for watching the stream and hanging out. We’ll see you all on the servers with 7.1. May the Force be with you.” - Charles Boyd.

Game Update 7.1, “Digging Deeper” launches free to all subscribers on August 2nd!

notes.title: Game Update 7.0.2 brings Weapons in Outfitter!
notes.notes:
With Game Update 7.0.2, we’re introducing a new functionality to the Outfit Designer: Weapons in Outfitter! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/6066147bbabb1c43aecb36053d4e5cbb759f3886.jpg[/img]

Outfit Designer is a feature we introduced with Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor. This feature allows players to change the appearance of their characters by creating up to 16 outfits using their favorite Armors and switching between them at any time. Since its introduction, several improvements have been made to Outfit Designer, such as preview window updates and, more recently, an improved user interface (UI). 

Similar to Armors in Outfitter, Weapons in Outfitter allows players to equip one weapon in the Gear window, which determines the stats applied to their character, and stamp the appearance of another weapon of the same type via the Outfitter window. For example, it is now possible for a player to benefit from the stats of the Stronghold Defender’s Lightsaber but enjoy the Reforged Derelict Lightsaber’s appearance. The weapon in the Outfitter slot (or weapons, for dual-wielding combat styles) also determines the sound and visual effects of your weapon with its unique audio, Color Crystal, and Weapon Tuning.

To use Weapons in Outfitter, open the Character Sheet, select an outfit from the Outfitter tab, and drop in the weapons you want to use in the Weapon slots. For this example, we equipped the Decurion Force-Lord’s Lightsaber in the Weapon slot of the Gear tab and dropped the Dark Honor Guard’s Unstable Lightsaber in the Weapon slot of the Outfitter tab. The character’s weapon now has the appearance of the Dark Honor Guard’s Unstable Lightsaber with the stats of Decurion Force-Lord’s Lightsaber! Once you’re satisfied with your selection, click on the ‘Commit’ button. 

And that’s Weapons in Outfitter! Players can check out this new layer of customization today!

notes.title: Game Update 7.0: Legacy of the Sith - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Note:[/b] As Game Update 7.0: Legacy of the Sith patch notes reached the character limit of Steam patch notes, only the highlights are posted. You can consult the entire patch notes on our website, [url=https://www.swtor.com/patchnotes/02152022/game-update-7.0-legacy-sith]here[/url].

[b]Highlights[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Storyline - Legacy of the Sith[/b] - This new expansion sends players to the darkest depths and farthest reaches of the galaxy in the pursuit of Darth Malgus.
[*] [b]New Planet - Manaan[/b] - The Sith Empire has invaded Manaan to seize its abundance of kolto, a vital medical resource on all sides of the war. 
[*] [b]New Flashpoint - Elom[/b] - Explore the ruined Sith Fortress on the planet Elom that was mysteriously erased from all records. 
[*] [b]Galactic Seasons 2[/b] - Launch of the second Galactic Season--Shadows of the Underworld! Earn new and exciting rewards by completing Season Objectives. 
[*] [b]Increased Level Cap[/b] - Increased level cap to 80 for all subscribers in Legacy of the Sith.
[*] [b]Combat Styles[/b] - More options than ever to customize your gameplay! More information [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20210806]here[/url]. 
[*] [b]Improved Player Experience[/b] - New character creation experience, along with new looks for the character sheet and inventory! 
[*] [b]Loadouts[/b] - Create pre-sets to easily manage your gear, weapons, abilities, and hotbars. 
[*] [b]Legendary items[/b] - These new items replace set bonuses for greater customization of the bonuses you receive. More information [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20211027]here[/url].
[*] [b]PvP Season 14[/b] - Season 14 of Ranked PvP has come to a close. New rewards can be found at Giradda the Hutt on the Fleet and players will receive rewards based off of their highest ranked rating when Season 15 starts later this year! More information about the PvP Season 14 Rewards [url=https://www.swtor.com/info/news/article/20211122-0]here[/url]. 
[*] [b]Ten-Year Anniversary[/b] - To celebrate The Old Republic’s Ten-Year Anniversary, the “Anniversary Personnel” Vendor will be available until January 2023. Their inventory has been updated to include new rewards and the Best View of SWTOR contest decorations.
[/list]

[*] [u][b]Conquest[/b][/u] - Prepare for Total War as tensions between the Empire and Republic increase leading into ‘Legacy of the Sith’! Total War Conquest will run for Conquest weeks beginning December 21st, January 4th, and January 18th.

notes.title: Update on Legacy of the Sith
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/bb32c77db03abc6ccd962a227be0dd3a7176f6ae.jpg[/img]

We have made the difficult decision to delay the release of Legacy of the Sith to February 15, 2022. 

Like many of you reading this, I personally cannot wait for the launch of our next expansion. I've greatly enjoyed my time exploring the depths of Manaan, testing out new story and ability combinations with Combat Styles, and more during internal playtests.

Legacy of the Sith is something the team has been hard at work on for quite a while but as we get ever closer to launch, it is clear that we need a bit more time. We’re focusing additional testing on the many areas we have changed throughout the game to deliver the experience we want, and one that you deserve.

In addition, during our public test server (PTS) your feedback was invaluable in helping us to shape this expansion. Outside of story content (to avoid spoilers) the majority of the expansion and its features will be returning to the PTS for all subscribers this week.

We're thrilled to celebrate the tenth anniversary of Star Wars: The Old Republic with all of you over the next year with Legacy of the Sith and more!

Thank you,

Keith Kanneg
Project Director

[list]

[*] The Elihsu’s holocall now correctly appears in the cinematic of “The Corpse Counters” Mission on Taris.

notes.title: Game Update 6.3.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Nar Shaddaa Nightlife is back![/b] - Head to Nar Shaddaa between June 29th at 12:00 UTC and August 10th at 12:00 UTC to test your luck on Smuggler’s Luck, Kingpin’s Bounty, and Emperor’s Grace slot machines to earn new and unique prizes!
[*] [b]Double XP Event[/b] - Starting June 29th at 12:00 UTC, and lasting until July 13th, enjoy two full weeks of Double XP, Valor, and Renown.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Free-to-play players can now create in-game bug report tickets with the /bug command.
[*] Increased the cap of Tech Fragments to 11000 (up from 10000).
[*] Corrected typos in the Legacy emote commands of the following classes:
[list]
[*] Sith Inquisitor
[*] Sith Warrior
[*] Jedi Knight
[*] Jedi Consular
[/list]

[list]

[*] /thanks
[*] /cong

[*] /congrats
[*] /lol
[/list]
[*] It is no longer possible for players to go over the Item Rating cap of 306.
[*] Darkside corruption is now correctly displayed on Nautolans in the character sheet, outfits, and after an area transition.
[*] Chat no longer appears blank after linking the Commemorative Statue of Dread Master Brontes several times.
[*] Spacing has been added to the bottom of the Item and Amplifier tooltips for better readability.
[*] The tooltip of the Bioanalysis Efficiency Amplifier is now correctly referencing Archaeology in French and German.
[*] Corrected typo on the word “gladiatorial” throughout the game.
[*] Emotes are no longer case sensitive, so you can /dance, /DANCE, or /dANce to your heart's content.
[*] Corrected a typo in “Defeat the Republic Commander - Master Mode” Achievement.
[*] A Legacy Bank has been added to the VIP area of the Fleet for both factions.
[*] There is now an Arrival Point Terminal in the first room next to the elevator of the Kaas City Apartment Stronghold.

[*] Clicking the Preview button for Paxton Rall in the Collections now correctly opens a new window with the Companion.
[*] Players who previously completed Chapter IX: The Alliance of Knights of the Fallen Empire can now obtain Nico Okarr through his Holocommunicator, as intended.
[*] The Weekly Login Subscriber reward now correctly shows as unclaimable for unsubscribed players.
